text: It's not very far from Ximen MRT Station, about 15 minutes' walk. The exterior looks a bit dated, and the equipment in the room is a bit unflattering. The toilet wires are exposed, and I feel there is a risk of electric shock at any time.
Very dangerous for old people bathing in bathtub. No privacy changing.

Pluses

It is my favorite hotel in all of Asia and one of my reasons for visiting Taiwan. "Grand"  is a fitting name.

I love the traditional motif.

I stayed at the hotel in 2019. It was a windowless room, #811. Although no window, it was so elaborately designed I felt very comfortable, like I was back in traditional China. 

This time around (2024) we were given a room in the annex. It was ok, not great. Design more plain, layout not very efficient (not enough horizontal space to put things. Had to put baggage and belongings on carpet, though there was plenty of floor space to have put in a holder). We asked for a room change the next night, got one in the main building. Made all the difference. Perfect layout, views, much more efficiently laid out, especially holders to put luggage etc. on.

The lobby and common areas are worth the stay. One could spend an hour or so exploring the shops, mazes, and wondering what surprises are next.

We took a tour of the secret tunnels built by the Chiang Kai-shek regime, as a way for them to escape should there be trouble.

Swimming pool was nice. 50 meters. Be sure to ask the front desk for directions. Otherwise a five-minute walk to the pool area could turn into 20-plus minutes going down and up a steep hill.

Minuses

The first night at the annex (room 1211?) had a bathroom door that was poorly designed and dangerous. My son and I both had our fingers crushed because the (heavy) door and door sill were not aligned. It slid beyond the wall. Our fingers were the door stop. We could have been injured. Grand Hotel, please fix this as soon as possible!!!

Rooms cold (in December). The heater didn't work. The staff told us that the hotel is under center heating. We needed comforters. We asked for two more per bed. Staff brought one plus a heater. I felt they  knew this was going to be an issue. Why have controls on the wall if they don't work?

Good location near Taipei Main Station, big rooms, great breakfast. However service is not as good as it used to be. Probably understaffed as most hotels nowadays. Room gives an unpleasant smell. Rooms near Main Road too noisy at night. Shower in a Bathtub, can be dangerous to get in and out
Shower in the bathtub is dangerous for older people

There was a gap between the glass door of the shower room and the floor, so hot water leaked out the door and made the bathroom floor soggy.
The shower room floor was slippery and dangerous.
No hot water came out.
There was a bathtub, but it was the wrong size (square and narrow) so you couldn't relax in it.
There was a wooden frame on top of the bathtub, but I didn't know how to use it, and it took up space and got in the way.

Does the front desk speak Japanese?
I can speak Chinese so it wasn't a problem, but I wonder if they would be able to accommodate a Japanese person who doesn't speak Chinese?

In Taipei, even in most cheap hotels, the front desk can speak Japanese.

I didn't see any Japanese guests.

First thing we get is strong musty smell when we opened the door to the room.

Stayed there for the location, very near taipei railway station. Clear instructions from station to the hotel.

Dangerous bathing area within narrow bathtub that trips my boy.

Welcome tea in terms of voucher to exchange drinks with their cafe which tastes great.

Nice bed and clean bed compared to the rest of the room

I am traveling with my family. It can be reached by a 5-minute walk from Exit 2 of Xiaonanshan. The bathroom and surrounding facilities are good, and there is also capsule coffee. The only problem is the socket 🔌. Only by finding it before use can we avoid the electric shock. I hope your hotel can Check the safety of sockets to give travelers who use electricity more peace of mind!
The water pressure in the shower was weak. The air conditioning didn't work, so it was hot during the day and cold at night, making it difficult to adjust the temperature.
Good hotel, a bit old, my room lock didn't work, but the staff was nice

Good location 
But our quad room wasn’t well prepared for our stay, water clogged in basin, bathtub with hairs

very close to MRT station, staff are nice.
Still using centralised air-con, the room temperature cannot change, too hot.

The early Yangmingshan Chinese Hotel was changed to the MACAU. The original iconic blue swimming pool is still there. I dined here 3 years ago. This time I had a bad impression from the reception. A guest at the counter reported that there was no hot water. The staff responded by asking the engineering staff to take a look. They said that the peak usage during dinner time would be smaller! How can a hotel of this standard use the same water as at home? ?
What you get is not a door card, but two wooden keys with room numbers on them. Remember to turn the key 3 times to lock the door when you go out!
The milky white sulfur hot springs in Yangmingshan National Park are highly corrosive. There are black chemical traces on the electroplating and wood in the room. The ventilation is poor and windows need to be opened. The toilet is old and the toilet seat shakes. Other impressions are expressed in photos. The only good service was when I got home I received a call saying that there was something left in the room, but it was unimportant and I asked the housekeeping to just throw it away.

I stayed at this hotel for four nights and was quite disappointed with several aspects of the stay. First, the air conditioning in the room was not cool enough. One night it was so hot that I had to use a small fan I had brought with me just to get some sleep. In addition, there was a persistent unpleasant smell coming from the bathroom throughout my stay, which made the room uncomfortable.

What frustrated me the most, however, was the deposit policy. The hotel requires a deposit of 1,000 TWD per night — in my case, 4,000 TWD for four nights — and only accepts credit card payments for it. This was not mentioned when I booked the room. I only found out during check-in, at which point it was too late to cancel. Even worse, the deposit wasn’t refunded until a full month after I checked out.

Overall, this experience was enough for me. I won’t be staying here again and wouldn’t recommend it to others.
Good location but the hotel too old , no hot water, air conditioner leaking of water throughout the lights bulb, the towels with bad smell.

Great location, right next to metro. Room clean and tidy.
Some suggesting, shower water facing bathroom door, water leaked out to bedroom and wet floor. A suitable thickness mat to absorb water that can go beneath the door should be placed to avoid wet floor.

Stayed in this so-called 5-star hotel for 3 nights. The power went out continuously from 2am on the second night. The fire indicator light on the ceiling was on and off, and it was on for a long time from 4am, which affected my sleep all night. There was no hot water or WiFi on the third morning. When I went out at 11am, there was no elevator for guests, so I had to use the staff elevator. When I came back at 6pm, I was still using the staff elevator.
Until you check out, there is no formal apology or explanation, as if these things never happened.




I highly recommend not staying at this hotel and will never consider staying at this group of hotels

Travel with family ,booked 3 rooms for 5 nights.Hotel aircon not working,  staff tried hard but still not cold at all.   Need stand fan to cool room.   One room toilet WC not working, sometimes can flush, sometimes not.  & hv no  chance to change, as hotel fully booked. Finally given chance to change on last night stay.

Hotel breakfast is 0k, except no staff service. Everything self service, including to move/ clear own rubbish & own plates after eating.

requires improvement
1) door is off track
2) water leaks out shower room door
Very central and many bus options, after showering water is leaking out of the shower

The hotel was clean and nice, but the location was inconvenient because I had to take a shuttle.

There was also a Family Mart inside.

The heater didn't work well, so I requested heater service and slept warmly.

I'm satisfied with the cost-effectiveness.

I booked it only because of its location near the airport MRT. Since it was built in 1973, the plumbing facilities were particularly old. The shower was broken and when I told the staff they fixed it.
It was cleaned, but the carpet felt dusty and dirty overall. You don't have to carry your suitcase, it's self-service like a business hotel.
Air conditioner is not working properly, after changing rooms it is still the same..
The water of the bathtub clogged. The heater of the aircon is not working. The hotel rate considered pricy with these condition.

The location is perfect. Their service was great. We were delighted and thankful that they offered us a free room upgrade. The buffet breakfast we paid separately was fine but a bit overrated. The room is outdated despite some updates. There's still a significant step into the bathroom which can be a hazard to older people. The bathtub that also serves as the shower is so high that I almost hurt myself when trying to step in. Also the toilet in our unit had a leak which should have been spotted and fixed prior to our occupancy. There appears to be some gap in their inspection and maintenance processes. Thankfully they fixed it after we reported the issue. Overall it's a fine hotel but I wouldn't rate it a five star despite its unbeatable location.

On the first day of check-in, I checked in by myself and was told that I couldn't find my reservation (and I finally found a staff member on duty to help me)
Then, the elevator light was broken and it was completely dark. I had to use the iPhone flashlight to press the floor button.
The air conditioning in the room is not good enough. No matter how long it is on, it shows 24 degrees and there is no way to adjust it.
When booking the room, we sent an email requesting a late check-out time of 12 noon (fully aware that it depends on the situation). When we went downstairs to ask on the last night, the staff still said they couldn't be sure and asked us to call downstairs tomorrow morning to ask again (generally speaking, other hotels know the check-in situation the night before, so they should be able to confirm the check-out time as well?)

Nice location and facilities, friendly staff, comfortable room.  I have got a small problem of water leaking from the shower section.  Luckily it was not too serious and didn't really affect my stay and feeling about the hotel.
The bathroom sink was cracked and water was leaking from the shower head. The room was spacious and easy to use, but overall it felt old.

Hotel room was pretty small, location was good, mini marts, restaurants, cafes nearby. Can improve further on the cleanliness of the room. Air con was not working well during my stay and had to borrow a fan.

Worst hotel experience ever, bar none.

This road trip

Upon arriving at the gate, no one greeted us. We walked to the front desk to check in and park. The receptionist said we could drive to the parking lot and then come back to the front desk to check in. We had to drive our luggage into the parking lot and then check in at the front desk. After checking in, the staff only gave us our room cards and explained breakfast and candy arrangements, but then ignored us. We and our two children carried our luggage to our room on our own, with no staff to accompany us. The room was very small, and the single bed was very narrow.

The floor was very low, and when we showered, water would leak out, soaking the entire bathroom. The water hadn't dried up by the next day. The room was sloppy, and the bottled water wasn't refilled.

We went for breakfast at 9:30 AM, but they wouldn't refill the food. The dishes and cups were gone, and they weren't actively refilling them. I saw everyone else using soup bowls for coffee, essentially using whatever was left. The next day, the candy bag disappeared. When I asked the front desk for another, they had to explain where the previous one went and reminded me not to lose it and to recycle it. I had to repeatedly remind my child not to lose the plastic bag.

This is definitely not hotel quality; at best, it's just hotel service. I was very disappointed. I definitely won't be back again and do not recommend staying at the Taipei Garden Hotel.

Midnight power shutdown. Not informed in advance. Blew hairs half way and charging power bank and handphones to prepare for early morning flight half way too. Was told 6am power will be up, but not as up at 6am. Lifts not working. Very bad. Shower water pressure weak too. Won’t come back to this hotel anymore.
Toilet floor floods but all else ok. Good location and near train station, the daily collection of  snacks were a plus for my daughter.
The hot spring water in the room is not hot, and the air conditioner is not cool at all. In the summer, the air conditioner is not cool enough to sleep. The overall living experience is not good.

Booked for two nights but got 3 different rooms! The first room 720 is really uninhabitable, the walls are moldy, the shower curtain is moldy, there are no sockets at the bedside, and there is thick dust behind the bedside table; I moved to the second room 825, although it is much better, the hygiene of the toilet is still worrying, outside the bathtub and trash can They all have hair, and the Internet is not working, the Internet is super slow. I was moved to another room on the second night for 320. Everything else was fine, but the shower head was broken. It was so frustrating! I just stayed for two nights and left immediately. The location of this hotel is not very good. It is still a bit far away from Ximending, and there is no convenience store downstairs. If you don't want to affect your travel mood because of accommodation, I really don't recommend staying there. This hotel!

Stayed in a quad-room and it is nicely maintained.
The staff at main entrance is very detail oriented.  On the 1st day, he rushed to elevator to show us how to use door access card to activate our access when we were still thinking why the elevator button did not work.

Good location but hotel room is very old, my fisrt room was in the corner at 6 floor with big room 1 big bed + 1 small, the aircon in bed room did not work and cannot increase the aircon temp at living room cause its system is old, very weak of wifi and phone cellula when move from living room to bed room (cannot chat, watch youtube, even use any medie like IG , FB). 
Good that staff is willing to let me change the room, better wifi but still not fast and the room is look old (TV is still old TV) , the hotel room floor is carpet and feel dusty so dont recommend someone who sensitive for dusty allegy. Moreover, even turn off room aircon the room is still feel cold and not warm as expected.

I like the layout with separate living room.
However, the shower head of my room was broken that cause the water spread out shower room to the floor.

It's an old building and the facilities are old, but it feels like they're barely holding on without any further investment.
The shower head was broken so I asked for it to be replaced and they replaced it with a worse one.
The head is not fixed and water is spraying onto the wall... 
I think this is my first time seeing a hotel that goes through the Keys. 
The view from the restaurant is good, but there is no view from my room.
There is breakfast, but there is nothing to eat.
I can hear noise from cars on the road, but it's not enough to disturb me.
Why do I wake up to the sound of the morning alarm next door..? 
The location is not very good. It is quite far to Ximen Station.

This was a bad experience. I didn't expect to encounter this kind of situation in W Hotel. I stood at the front desk waiting to check in but no one paid attention to me. The front desk staff lady only provided selective services. I stood and waited but she ignored me. She went to serve a newly arrived traveler. If this kind of service is required, they shouldn't charge this kind of price. There was no sound in the speakers in the room. The maintenance personnel came and said they were afraid of disturbing other guests so they couldn't turn it up louder. As a result, the sound of the speakers was quieter than my phone. No one helped me find a taxi downstairs in the hotel. Several waiters were enjoying the air conditioning inside. It might be because the weather was too hot. This W in Taiwan is worse than other Ws in other places. You can blacklist them.

Only stayed one night so I did not have much experience there.  But, one night that I stayed, obviously air conditioner was not working and room was freezing cold.  Called room service twice, they looked like pretended to fix, as it was obvious, AC wasn't fixed at all.  Service staff told us wait 20 min.  and room will be warm, but  it did not.  So on the third attempt, went front desk.  I thought they may change the room but, instead, they gave us an oil heater.  Oil heater was strong enough to warm up the room, but it was quite noisy turning off and on every 10 min that kept me wake half of the night.  
Excluding this experience, bellboys were sincere and helpful, hotel itself is visually enjoying to see.

Hotel a bit run down leading to general disappointment. Our room smelled heavily of mold/ mildew upon entering which we found out later was probably because of pipe leakage as there was massive water leaking every time the tub shower head was turned on. The entry corridor lights didn’t turn on and It was also very hot in the room and the AC took a very long time to cool. We reported issues as soon as we discovered it but as it was already midnight by the time we checked in, we asked the service team to change the room the next day. Our new room was fine but small details such as the door handle decorative knob was loose (visibly hanging off the screw), the higher part of the walls were covered in visible dust. 
Overall the stay was okay but not in-line with their (former) five star hotel branding.

Write bad for your **, kettle is broken, phone is broken, air conditioning is broken, service attitude is 10 points worse, than such an expensive room rent, but the room everything is broken, sheets 10 points dirty, ten questions nine do not answer, ￼￼￼￼ simply garbage￼

The air conditioner in the room was not cool. After the waiter came to repair it, it was still at 25 degrees. It was not cool at all... The phone in the room also did not work. I came here based on Ig's recommendation. It was a bit disappointing.

The walls were moldy. My key card stopped working at least three times. The bathroom faucet was broken and just sprayed water everywhere uncontrollably, like a car being hosed down. It then flooded the bathroom. If you're considering staying here, you've been warned.

Very big room, great location but for the money paid, facilities should have been better/newer. 
1. Onsen bathtub in the room has some obvious stains
2. Water leaked from bathroom to sofa area after shower (not a lot of water luckily) 
3. Power went off for like 1-2 sec twice. Though very briefly, needa turned on TV and lights again one by one, which was kinda troublesome (and not what I expected from a hotel this expensive)
The room is very simple, the toilet flushing power is not enough, and the toilet is often clogged

The shower was clogged and flooded, making it impossible to use. We discovered the issue too late to switch rooms. The next morning, the engineering department explained it was a renovation flaw, specifically that the shower's floor or threshold wasn't properly installed. Their solution was to suggest we use a towel to block the water! For a price tag of over 300 AUD a night, this offers extremely poor value. The overall experience was very disappointing.

I booked Santos hotel because I had a fairly good experience staying for several days in 2019. However, this time around, we were disappointed by a number of things, most especially how humid the entire building was. Our clothes always felt slightly damp, towels would not dry fully within 48 hours, and we noticed that the dehumidifiers in the hallway were almost always full. Hot water takes some time to manifest in the shower, and the toilet was prone to persistently "running" after flushing, (i.e. water kept flowing). The safe in our room did not work (out of battery). Staff were reluctant to give us a second blanket and hand soap, but did after we persisted in asking. Overall, compared to other hotels stays we have had in Taiwan, Santos Hotel was unfortunately the worst and left a lot to be desired. We hope the hotel improves in the future.

The hotel`s facility is too old and  paticularly in the bath room. 
Plug in bath tab  was out of  order　,shower hed did not work  properly  and wet　floor after take barhing etc,.

The shower was broken and not fixed, which was inconvenient, but the water pressure was good and the hot water came out well, which was nice.
The key is not a card key type, and the window opens only a little.
The food was not very varied, but it was edible, and the view was good, so I was satisfied with the food.
The view from the restaurant made up for all the complaints.
Smokey smell bathroom , no hot water machine otherwise ok

Booked this hotel last minute, checked in very late. The road up the mountain is a bit winding but not sparsely populated. The environment is OK. The air is filled with a strong smell of sulfur. Surprisingly, there is an indoor personal hot spring pool. The breakfast is also good. The swimming pool is also great. It takes about 20 minutes to call a taxi. It costs 500NT to go directly to Songshan Airport. This price, facilities and services are great value. There are a few problems that I hope the hotel can pay attention to and deal with in time. The first is that there is no Wi-Fi signal on the first floor. The second is that the air-conditioning controller in the room seems to be out of order. If it is set to 24 degrees, whether the air-conditioning is turned on or only the air is sent, it is actually stable at 19 degrees, which is quite cold. It is very stuffy when the air-conditioning is turned off. I have reported these two problems to the front desk staff. Unfortunately, there has been no solution in two days.

Very nice hotel! The service was excellent! Clean and hygienic! Every service staff is warm and kind! If it weren’t for the fact that there was no room at the back! I would stay a few more days! A little incident happened in the middle of the night! I don’t know why water is leaking from the toilet light! We will help you quickly after making a complaint! I will stay here again next time if I have a chance! Thank you to every service staff in the hotel!
Cost is decent but the shower room will have water leakage into toilet room, which is not good
There was no hot water in the middle of the night... The service staff actually asked us to check out. Are they trying to kick us out in the middle of the night?
The toilet leaked after showering, but the hotel restaurant offers a 25% discount on meals, which is very attractive.

The room is relatively large and clean and tidy overall, but the towels feel old and not soft enough and are rough to wipe. The flushing force of the toilet bowl is not strong enough and it is easy to get clogged. After the blockage, the water accumulated and flushed several times to resolve it😥
The air conditioner is broken and I can't adjust the temperature; it's freezing cold, but everything else is fine.

Located not far from the MRT station n many convenient shops surrounding and room consider big.
Room a bit dusty but still acceptable. One of the room bathroom ceiling is leaking water that very annoying. Overall still good to stay in.

This hotel is very outdated and reeks of mold. The shower area shower head had black mold surrounding each of the water nozzles. There was no hot water at night either. The walls had mysterious stains and the bed was very hard and uncomfortable, with the AC blasting straight into your face while you lay in bed. I don’t recommend this hotel, it’s very old and the smell made me sick.

The hotel is of course a 5-star hotel, it is a weak four-star hotel with elements of a three-star hotel, but its location, breakfast acceptable for a European, daily cleaning, and the responsiveness of the staff make it a worthy choice if you come for a couple of days to an exhibition or to negotiate with suppliers. The hotel has 17 floors, but even on the 15th it is very noisy. The air conditioner makes noise like an airplane warming up, there is no soap, no dental kit, but there is a warm bidet lid and excellent plumbing and the drain is not clogged. The crowd is quiet and calm. You can take the hotel, it is worth the money.
hotel aircon not working well

Property response to questions prior to arrival is below expectations compared to some other hotels. 
Toilet bidget didn't work well . Staff did come to check upon reporting. So that is ok. 
At times the counter only has one person attending to guests. So long wait if you want to ask a question with the hotel. 
The hotel is about 10 to 15 min walk to eateries.   Same for sub way. 
Overall experience is still ok.

the door lock is broken
Sound insulation is poor

The price of the hotel is much higher than that of nearby hotels. When I checked in at the hotel, the staff still informed me that I would be able to check in at 4 pm and check out at 11 am tomorrow morning. This is difficult for me to accept. Most hotels check in at 3 pm at the latest. You can check in and some hotels can already check you in around 1 pm. Many of the hotel's facilities are very dilapidated. The hairdryer in the locker room in the hot spring area is still broken. The only thing that can be earned is that the hotel's breakfast is more diverse than other hotels. The taste is better, and the dinner is almost the same as an ordinary Japanese restaurant. The experience this time is very bad, so just give it a try. This Japanese Kagaya in New Beitou is too far behind.
Excellent location. Staff were friendly and knowledgeable. The only setback was to adjust the tap to get to the right temperature when taking a shower. It's either too cold or too hot.

I was given a room with water leaking problem, which they have a dirty towel next to the bathtub to soak up the moisture. The towel was already molding, which is very concerning. 
After I was successfully request a change of room. There's no leaking issue, however, there blood stain presented in the room. The ventilation is filled with dust. 
I have stayed in 3 properly by Check Inn. I could say this is the worst not only by Check Inn group, but as a hotel in general. The overall feeling is horrible.
Very dated hotel. Had to change room due to smoke smell. Not very clean and no hot water in shower. Location is convenient to MRT. Need an update to secure better review.

The room air conditioning does not work well no matter how we adjust the fan speed nor temperature. The room is freezing.  At the end of the day we switched off the air conditioning and opened the room windows instead.

The hotel is close to the railway station and is convenient for travel. However, the hotel has a bit of history and the facilities are old. I just checked in and did not use the bathroom. Water has leaked from the ceiling at the bathtub and wash basin and dripped on the floor. There are a lot of water stains. It really needs to be improved.

However, the hotel staff has a very good attitude and is very enthusiastic to help deal with and answer the guests' needs. praise!

The nearest station is MRT Songshan-Xindian Line Nanjing Fuxing Station. I haven't used it, but exit 1 has an elevator, so it might be better for heavy luggage. Following the instructions on the official website, we exited from exit 2, crossed Nanjing East Road to the north, and arrived. The front entrance has a large drop-off area, making the pedestrian path narrow, so it seems difficult to pass with a large suitcase. I carefully crossed the drop-off area while watching for cars and headed towards the entrance.

The front desk staff greeted us in perfect Japanese. I showed them a photo of the cosmetics I was asked to buy as a souvenir and asked, "Are there any drugstores nearby that might carry this?" They called several stores to check their stock availability.

The deluxe king room is spacious, located on the 8th floor facing south towards Nanjing East Road. The soundproofing is good, and I couldn't hear any traffic noise, so it was quiet. Upon entering the room, there is a cloakroom with a safe. There are 4-5 hangers, a thick bathrobe, a yukata, and slippers. The low board serves as both a place for extra luggage and a workspace with a TV and a landline telephone. There is an empty refrigerator beneath the low board. The floor is spacious, so there shouldn't be any issue with luggage space. There is a small table by the bedside that is suitable for snacking. There are lighting desks on both sides of the bed, with a cordless phone on one side. The bedding and pillows are of high quality, allowing for a comfortable sleep.

The bathroom is spacious with a tub, but it takes quite a bit of time to fill because it's a large tub. Inside the bathroom, there is a shower booth separated by a glass door, equipped with liquid body soap, shampoo, and conditioner. Be careful to close the glass door firmly, or the shower water will leak outside. In the vanity area, there are a toothbrush, toothpaste, a comb, and a hairdryer in the small items holder. There is solid soap for handwashing and aroma oil. Note that the toilet cannot flush paper.

There is a smoking room on the 3rd floor available 24 hours.

Air condition is broken 
Leck with manpower but good service

Like I stated at the topic, the room is a bit old, and in the last day of my trip the shower was not working ( no hot water coming out from the tap), so we had to switch our room, not a very good experience i will say

Very poor service, toilet does not work, breakfast included in the restaurant but it is not included, the room I booked is charged an additional fee, check out at 11 o'clock, toothbrush needs to be purchased

Though rooms are spacious considering the sizes in Taipei, but the rooms are dated and the sliding glass door for the bath/shower area was faulty for ours. The AI control box was useful for turning off all the lights after getting into bed. It was also rather slippery in the tub, which is also where u shower. The shampoo/shower gel were good. Not sure why they needed a transparent glass panel  between the room and the toilet/shower area where u have to close the curtain.  No minibar other than coffee/tea/bottled water. Not very near stations, need to walk 15min to Ximending. 
Sound proofing isn’t good as every night I could hear the other residents talking loudly along walkway and also flushing their toilets, etc. 
The free snacks and welcome drinks were a nice touch.

The room is spacious, the view is great, the bathroom is large, but the bathtub water is not hot enough, the electronic scale is broken, the sauna area is too small and crowded, the breakfast is rich and large, but the eggs are average quality, and the omelette is too hard.

There is no hot water at all for taking a shower at night. The shower will get colder with each shower. I was given a bathtub room but I couldn't enjoy it at all. I called the housekeeping and they just said that the weather was too cold, so there was nothing I could do. The water is currently so warm.

But excluding this factor, the rest is a very good experience! Moreover, there is a shuttle service that allows tourists to easily travel to and from night markets and restaurants.
Close to the busy shopping area. We took taxi everywhere. The staff is great. The shower head was broken but they fixed it. It is outdated but clean.

The location was right next to Taipei Main Station, making it very convenient for getting to the airport and other areas. The facilities were also conveniently connected to Shopping All, which was nice. I appreciated the Dawollcom wine and fruit. However, the bathtub was a bit unclean, and the fruit was hard and underripe, which was a bit of a concern. Also, since the bathtub is outside, the room was humid, and the water leaked outside, so I think some improvements are needed. Overall, I had a nice rest. Also, it would be a good idea to post a notice about the outdoor pool. We didn't know about it, so we were a little disappointed.

Despite the luxurious front desk, lobby, and interior, the prices are reasonable and the value for money is great.

There are shops nearby that are open early in the morning, so it's nice to stop by a local shop while taking a walk.

Ximending Station is just a short walk away, so access to each area is easy!

There are no amenities such as toothbrushes, hairbrushes, or razors, so you need to purchase them at a nearby convenience store.

Also, the bathroom curtain is short, so the area around the toilet gets flooded when you use the shower. (It's not a problem to use it, but I thought it would be difficult to clean.)

The staff were polite and I would like to use it again 👍

Have experienced 7.2 magnitude earthquake in Taiwan while staying, staff managed efficiently for the need of hotel guests. 

Our room had tidy up and checked in few hours.  When a broken tile found on the toilet wall, hotel arranged us to swap to another room once we back to hotel from outside. 

Thanks again for the professional services. The style of twin room is a little bit old fashioned but is spacious. My kid like a park is just next to the hotel
The washbasin faucet is broken, and the toilet drain and switch are broken.

The Miramar Garden Hotel is a decent option for a short stay in Taipei. The staff are very friendly and accommodating, and the breakfast buffet is pretty solid (although it is a unique mixture of Western and Taiwanese foods that might not appeal to all palates). I did feel that it was a bit overpriced. The beds have a very thin bedspread, and the only sheet is used as a mattress protector. The showers are not very user friendly either, and some of the members of my group reported their showers leaking water into the bathroom. The cleanliness of the rooms was okay. Certain areas looked like they needed a good dusting, and the bathroom tile looked a bit stained (hopefully not moldy) in places. Overall, it’s not a bad hotel that is fairly close to the MRT main station as well as several restaurants.

On March 21, 2025 at approximately 11:30 PM, my family had no hot water for showering.  
I went downstairs to the front desk to inquire what was going on and why.

An employee named Paul said the hot water system was being repaired because too many guests were using the hot water and asked me to report to the duty manager the next day. Paul then called the engineering department and requested a technician to come and deal with the complaining guest.

The technician told me he didn't know when it would be fixed and there was no guarantee. At this point, the front desk clerk called Paul, but Paul had disappeared from the front desk.  
On March 22, 2025 at 7:30 pm, my family and I went to the front desk to inquire about the hot water system and whether there would be any compensation for not having hot water for showering last night. .

A female front desk employee named Zhang Jiayu offered to provide us with free breakfast the next morning, but we declined. Because we saw a review on Google that mentioned a couple complained about the afternoon tea buffet at Sande Hotel (Xiangyangting) and the wife started vomiting and diarrhea on 27/02/2025. We will not accept this offer as we cannot trust the quality of the food in your hotel.

Since we have paid for the hotel which includes hot water service for bathing, it is basic. So, it is reasonable to refund if this service is not met.

The female employee, Zhang Jiayu, said she could only offer a discount and would try to ask the manager on duty about the specific amount of the discount. 15 minutes later, we received a call from Zhang Jiayu in the hotel room, who told us that the manager on duty could provide a 5% discount as compensation!

This is absolutely ridiculous and insulting to the guests. We asked the Duty Manager to call us back, but the front desk lady, Zhang Jiayu, told us that the hotel Duty Manager would not call back guests.

Also, if you check out now, we can not charge you! What kind of attitude is this? You did something wrong and you ask the guests to leave? This is ridiculous! Totally unacceptable!

In addition, employee Zhang Jiayu asked us to speak Mandarin on the phone. As a hotel worker, English is the most important thing when dealing with people from different countries. She couldn't understand and asked the customer to communicate with her in Mandarin.

We will report this incident to the Taiwan Tourism Bureau.

I will never forgive the disrespect to the Sandes Hotel!
Old, the door is broken, there is a problem with the water supply in the toilet
Place was good and bathrooms generally clean. Service very good too. However the AC in my room was hot and at some point was leaking water.

Stayed 4 nights in a row. This room is not ideal and needs maintenance. The USB plug is not fast and you have to borrow a plug from the front desk. The toilet and bathroom door is leaking. The lighting in the room is not good and it is a bit dark. The bedding is a bit old. However, the service is considerate and friendly.

The location is excellent, but the room facilities are outdated. The bed is very hard, like sleeping on a wooden board, and the quilt is too thin. It is too cold to sleep at night, and the air conditioner is turned off and it is too hot.

I'm waiting for a waiter to come and check if the shower is working or not? I tell him there's no hot water... and I let it run for 2 minutes around 11 p.m.... you understand that someone gets into the shower, and I'm covered by a towel... strange situation...
Air-conditioning did not work during my entire stay

The front desk was polite and there were three people on duty, which made me feel at ease even though I checked out late at night.
There were some minor issues with the facilities, such as a broken TV, a leaking shower, and thin walls, but I was very satisfied.
It was really convenient as it was almost directly connected to Taipei Station Exit M3.

Since its inception in 1985, the hotel has not been very active in upgrading the hotel's hardware. In particular, ㅗ hotel facilities in toilets and rooms are concerned about safety issues. The corners are angled and the material is very hard. For this reason, we moved the room three times during the five days of stay. Of course, the hotel quickly changed the room, but there is a problem with the way it handled it. The problem must be observed with the hotel official, and the room was not exchanged until the problem was resolved. One day, the air conditioner did not work due to a problem with the electrical wiring, so the temperature in the room rose, and a problem I discovered around 5 a.m. was only after the technician came to check the problem, replaced the parts, and was prescribed a possibility of reoccurrence. The newly assigned room had a problem with the toilet, which was also asked to check until the next person resolved the problem. The housekeeper should not throw the toilet paper away in the toilet, but in the trash can placed in the bathroom. It is a request that does not fit the hotel rating and I cannot find the phrase to do so anywhere. I am satisfied with the size of the hotel room, the restaurant, and various facilities, but the too old hotel facilities and various problems that appear due to not being properly upgraded for a long time are factors that pull the evaluation of this hotel down.

It is a very dated hotel but generally clean and convenient from the Taipei Main MRT Station. I am travelling with my 70-year-old mum and it was a reasonable central location for us to travel easily via MRT and to the Airport.

As it is the middle of September 2024 and super HOT summer. Our first hotel room's aircon was faulty. We had to change to another room. Otherwise, this is quite a basic room with a slightly stained bathtub, TV, kettle and tea/coffee bags. No disposables  (toothbrush or cotton pads/buds) are given unless you ask!

Housekeeping is great and overall staff are super friendly and polite.

Booked a Superior twin room for 5 nites. Assigned one of the smallest room in the hotel more suitable for single occupancy. Room temp was uncontrollable and ranges from 16 - 18c. Requested room change and allocated a leftover handicap room. Room size was ok but there was no hot water at wash basin and room temp again was uncontrollable. Final 2nd. change of room came a requested portable heater. Stay was uneventful after that. 
Two issues need to be resolved:
1. Room originally assigned was not a superior twin (1518)
2. Second room assigned never really resolve customer issue of uncontrollable room temp.

I had a good stay on my previous visit  (Nov 2023) booking the same Superior Twin room for 5 nites. This trip we spend two days changing room.
I visit Taipei at least 4 times a year and stay about 20-22 nights. I am reluctant to recommend Cosmos to friends/relatives due to the inconsistent manner of room assignment abd room issues. May not stay at this hotel again if such issues arise again.

The location of Junpin Hotel is really great
After many years, I came to stay again
The decorations in the restaurant are still the same and the room is a bit old.
There are water leakage stains on the ceiling and the room is damp
A double bed room is two single beds put together
There is an uncomfortable partition in the middle🥹
There is a bathtub on the left hand side as soon as you enter the room. There is only a curtain pulled up to separate the toilet flow. It is very strange. It feels like staying in a business hotel? !
But it’s not bad to have a small balcony

The service staff in the lobby on the first floor are very polite. The atmosphere feels very comfortable as soon as I enter. Unfortunately, when I checked in on the sixth floor, a female service staff spoke very slowly and her attitude was not very positive~

There are service staff on the floor who often come in and out. This makes passengers feel at ease and will not be unable to find someone when they need to find someone temporarily.
The floor is also quite popular
A tall male service staff wearing glasses and a suit helped my mother get her bag because we were on the wrong floor and my mother felt a little uncomfortable. He also helped me take my mother back to our floor. Thank you for his thoughtfulness🫶 🏻!

The meat soup for breakfast is very delicious! 🫶🏻
The small egg tarts are also delicious
There is also hot soy milk that can be paired with fried dough sticks and sesame cakes, which is great

✍🏻No toothbrushes, combs, razors or shower caps are provided.
￼If you are staying, you have to bring your own

The room’s AC wasn’t working. We had to call the front desk several times in the middle of the night to request them to check the AC. In the end, we had to transfer to another room because the AC can’t be fixed.

The Grand Hotel is a classic and an architectural gem in itself. It is usually included in the tour itineraries. Room is spacious although aircon is not cool enough. It even has a nice balcony overlooking Taipei City. 

Breakfast food is bountiful but the taste caters more on Oriental taste not Western so it's best to dine in the Ala Carte style restaurant there if you want Western foods. 

They don't provide toothbrush kits unless you will ask. Internal hotel staffs are very helpful and efficient. Checking in and out are fast and very easy. 

However, in the restaurant or elsewhere, once food is brought to your table, bill will also be brought and you must already pay. 

Location while picturesque, is not conducive to walking as it is quite far from the city proper. They occasionally  have free shuttle buses during the weekends but they don't follow printed time schedule and the driver won't allow you inside the buses unless it is time (or unless they wanted to). One driver at the MRT Yuanshan Station did not allow us inside even if it is raining and we saw him sleep inside the bus after we left (This is on the late afternoon of June 17, 2024). We waited for an hour before he allowed us inside which we find not polite and inconsiderate to hotel guests and a waste of precious time. We thought that it is better to hire Uber taxi than ride in the shuttle buses. This should be improved by the hotel.
Hotel cost and expenses are better than Hong Kong and Singapore (for 5 star hotels), but it is pricier than Malaysia, Vietnam and Thailand.

Overall, our stay is okay and we can consider coming back.

The good:
1. The staff are very attentive and friendly.
2. The gym has free weights and an assortment of machines. Towels are provided, but I didn't see any sanitation wipes. There was also no water available, so bring your own bottle.
3. The food I ate was tasty (assortment of dim sum and appetizers).
4. A lot of nearby history for tourism and transportation availability for getting around.
The bad:
1. WiFi is shared across the whole building, not dedicated per room. If there are a lot of users, the internet can be slow or completely unusable. Very disappointing.
2. In-room A/C is the weakest at any hotel I've stayed at. The fan on high setting has no difference compared to the low setting. I set the room to 16 C and 3 hours later it is still at 22 C. 22 C isn't terrible, but the A/C seemed almost superficial.
3. The walls are very thin. You can hear people walking through the halls and talking, etc. even during quiet hours.
4.  The shower leaked/spilled outside into the main bathroom area.
5. The bathroom door is a heavy sliding door which I appreciate; however, there should be rubber stoppers to prevent it from slamming into the wall when opening or closing.

I personally would not recommend staying for full price, and would consider alternatives even at a similar discounted rate.

Location and staff are good.
The kettle is not working when we use it, shower head was broken while when use during bathing.Location and staffs are good but there are a few things that I am really pissed off and unsatisfied about. The kettle is not working when we first got the room, the shower head suddenly fell out when having shower, the sound cancellation between rooms are so bad, i could literally listen to what people were saying next door, the staff even threw my towel away when they doing the cleaning, we also have breakfast there which is till 10am and they already start putting the food back to the kitchen at 9:30am, how ridiculous. This is literally unacceptable, wouldn’t come back again

Above all, the air was so bad that I slept with a mask on. I still feel like a strange smell comes out of my nose when I breathe. And on the first day, it was a bit cold as there was no hot water. The pillows had a smell and there was no soundproofing at all so it was very noisy. For the sake of my health, I won't do it again even if they ask me to stay for free.

The environment, sanitation, and service are satisfactory. The facilities are not very good, and there is a problem with the ceiling of the shower room. The paint is peeling off, I am afraid of water leakage, the pillow is too flat, it is difficult to sleep, I wake up several times a night.

The facilities are old and the air conditioner is extremely cold and cannot adjust the temperature. Hygiene is also poor, there are visible stains on the sheets. There was no hot water on the first night. I will never order again even if I die.

Near to Xing Tian Temple (and station), as well as the other metro station ZhongShan GuoXiao, with convenient and great food nearby. Small night market nearby as well with great food (try ShuangCheng Night market!). Also convenient to travel to common tourist spots on the  orange, green, red and blue metro line. 

Hotel was clean and provided good hotel cleaning services. the hotel room was also big enough for 3 people, with enough luggage room as well. Staff was also quick to solve our shower drain clogging problem. Fast and efficient.
Booked 2 rooms, the air conditioning in both rooms is not cool. The hotel added a fan.
Although there is a bathtub for bathing 🛁, the switch of the shower head 🚿 cannot be pulled up and water cannot be discharged. I can only take a bath with leaking bathtub water.
The location is quite far away. The toilet was clogged on my second night. I called the front desk immediately for help, but it didn't get better. I hope the hygiene issues can be improved.

This is an old hotel. The room is on the small side. And the facilities are a bit old. This time in February, the weather was very cold and the hotel did not even have heating! Either you turn on the cold air or turn off the foot steamer. There is no other solution. This is unacceptable in this day and age. Besides, the price is not cheap. The shower head in the bathroom was broken and was not repaired. The walls of the room are very thin and the noise from the neighbors can be heard. The auntie started cleaning at 10am in the morning, and before 11am she put a note in the room saying that I missed the cleaning and I need to check with the front desk. Oh my god, what's going on? ! The overall check-in experience was not very good. I'll go somewhere else next time.

Overall, I would say the experience is average. I knew it was an old hotel before I went there, but I never expected the room to be so bad. The towels were not clean, there was water leaking under the wash basin, and the window was full of dust when I wanted to see the scenery. The room was cleaned very casually, and it was obvious that there was no vacuuming or sweeping. But one thing worth praising is that the staff was very friendly and answered all questions. But it costs HK$497/night (already the price of trip.com member discount, which is HK$353 less per night), and the location is not very convenient. It takes about 15 minutes to walk to the MRT (not very convenient to drag luggage), so the cost performance is very low for me.
frequent water choke during showers, musky smells and really bad service for a 5 star hotel. unable to shower in my own room due to flooding in the shower room.

The toilet flush is very powerful and the air conditioner is very cold. The bed is a bit hard, but not difficult to sleep on. This time on the fourth floor, the toilet was a bit noisy. Although it is an old hotel, the service is very good and very clean. The water pressure in the bathroom is high, but it is too hot, so you need to pay attention to the adjustment. It takes about 5 minutes to walk to the Wannian Building.

receive a upgrade gesture due to bad experience from previous stay. yet this stay is still not prefect. air conditioning is not working and have to change room after unpacking. 

location is good but do check your room condition before unpacking.
Hotel is tired and in need of refurbishment. Airconditioner in wardrobe leaked and made clothes on hangers wet and unwearable
Everything was very disappointing except the water quality of the hot springs but the facilities were worn out and disgusting the air conditioning wasn’t working properly, toilet was filthy
The air conditioner is out of order and it's too cold to turn up the temperature.

After arriving at the hotel, I was surprised by the loud noise my brand new suitcase made when it was dropped to the ground while unloading it from the taxi. It even had ceramic inside. After using the shower in my room, water leaked outside and I slipped. I contacted the hotel to change rooms, worried I might injure myself. However, I was moved to a smaller room, and the shower in my room was still leaking, even though it had been repaired. The woman who answered the phone when I changed rooms laughed at me, and finally said goodbye, saying I'd be staying until the next day. What terrible service! The bathroom had a loud, ear-splitting "crank-crank" sound coming from the ceiling all night, making it impossible to sleep. The coffee cup in the room was also extremely dirty, with tea stains and caked on it. The handle of the kettle got so hot when it boiled that it was almost impossible to hold. This was horrible hospitality. I'll never stay here again.
The floor mat is sticky, there was a water leakage in the toilet and I keep listen the water dripping to the bath tube from upstair in the mid night

Bad  and smelly rooms .with no hot water ..
Old bathroom which looked abandoned.
There are two buildings 1 old the other new ..
Stay in the new building if you can ..after booking my room and arriving at. 11pm 
The people at the reception wouldn’t allow me to change the room to the new building..
Pictures are deceiving on Agoda ..
Not the real pictures that you get .

It looks like a really old hotel but its still pretty well maintained. Staff were helpful and nice, room was nice and the tiles on the bathroom wall were kinda cute in a vintage way. Only complaint is that the toilet bowl leaked from the bottom at the end of the visit.

Stayed for 2 nights during the Chinese New Year. The toilet got clogged within 10 minutes after I entered the room. I told the front desk and they asked service staff to come and unclog it, but they said they would call for repairs. I asked to change rooms, but the room at the very end was very uncomfortable. I told them again if we could move to a different room, and they helped us move to another room, which was much better. The hotel is located near Ximending, which is a very good location, but the hotel facilities are old and there are not many charging points.

This time, the air conditioner on the floor is fine, but the room lock is broken, so I notified the front desk to send someone to deal with it immediately. The efficiency is very high. When taking a shower in the Keshi toilet, be careful when the water flows on the floor. The CP value is good, you can stay again.

The room was at the level of a budget hotel. I didn't take photos of the hotel. The toilet broke twice, the body scale was broken, and the front desk didn't feel the slightest bit of enthusiasm when I checked in at 7am. Most of the service staff were very enthusiastic, and breakfast was the highlight.

My stayed in Taipei Garden Hotel is quite satisfactory. The only disappointment was the aircon faulty on the 3rd night. However, hotel staff managed to change another quadraple room for us within 30mins.

The lifts from the ground floor to the lobby are extremely slow, which I don't quite understand since it is only six floors up; the lifts from the lobby to the rooms are fine though. 

You can request an extra bed for only some types of rooms (the more expensive ones) which I understand because of the limited size of the rooms. However, the extra beds are really expensive, way above the median, almost half of what I paid for the room.

The fitness room, located on the 8th floor, normally closes at 10pm, but you can request to use the gym 24/7, however you will need to sign a waiver, which I thought was inconvenient for a five star hotel.

The best part was when I tried to use the shower, the drain didn't work properly and the water went everywhere. Thankfully the maintenance and housekeeping staff were quick in responding to this emergency at midnight.
The light came on by itself in the middle of my sleep, and they said it was a power outage or something. It was almost dawn when I recovered.
TV not working. Toilet water leakage. Missing toilet paper. Lobby too many people

This hotel is by far the worst hotel we ever stayed and we had to leave 1 day earlier and move to another hotel. Yes, that’s how bad this is. -the room is dirty and full of stain on wall, ceiling and furniture -the room smell bad and damp, AC not working properly -mould found next to AC vent -a used plaster sticked onto my bed sheet -staff refuse to change room for us even we showed them the evidence -will never stay here again -my friend and family felt sick after staying in this hotel Please be prepared if want to stay here

The hotel is terrible. There was no hot water for showering. The temperature felt only 8 degrees tonight. I called the front desk, but found that the phone was broken and could not be used. I could only use roaming data to make the call. Finally, at around midnight, the technician came up to fix it. He placed all the tools on the bed, but still couldn't fix it. He could only use the lobby phone outside the room, and there was still no hot water.

We booked a Family Room with one Queen bed and one signle bed for 4D3N. The first night we already found bug in the toliet. The second night water leaked in the bathroom. Last night another bug was found in the bathroom. Front Desk Staff could show more passion when greeting guest checl-in.

It should be a renovation of an old building. The room is big, but it feels old. There are 2 elevators in total, one of which is out of order due to the earthquake, so the waiting time is long... The room card on the day of check-in could not open the room. I ran back and forth three times before changing the room. It seems that the induction door lock was out of power~

The location is good and the rooms are big, which is totally inconsistent with the level of a five-star hotel. (Booked 9 nights, two rooms)
The hardware equipment is outdated. For the first time, the room my parents were assigned had a noticeable odor and there were multiple stains on the carpet. The second time I stayed there for a few days, I returned to my room one day and found that the bathroom was leaking badly. It was like a waterfall flowing down from the ceiling. I had to change rooms immediately. (The hotel said the toilet tank upstairs was leaking).
The service attitude (especially that of the supervisors) is appalling (for example, I suspect that the hotel's SOP for responding to emails is to make a series of calls, dial the room number to find the guest, and harass the guest with his or her particularly harsh phone tone - more than one supervisor does this. For example, supervisors at the upper and lower levels say different things and try to fool customers.) It's a long story, and a few thousand words are omitted below. But to be honest, the attitude of the grassroots staff is still very good. I noticed that many of the hotel's receptionists, restaurant staff, and room service staff are so-called foreign workers in Taiwan. Their service was proactive, professional, and courteous, which was the highlight of this stay!
Regent Taipei is a long-established five-star hotel in Taiwan. In contrast, Boss Pan recently published a book emphasizing "putting oneself in others' shoes and achieving a sense of happiness through hospitality spirit." It is obvious that there are big problems with internal management, and the aging hardware equipment also urgently needs to be updated and improved. I hope Mr. Pan can show the courage to restore Jinghua’s former reputation.

Pros: Breakfast is great, the staff is friendly and service is good
Cons: Though the hotel seems refurbished, but the equipment is old and the toilet is clogged. The toilet has bad smell sometimes

The hotel room has an AI assistant which is fascinating for us! However the AI in the first corner room we were in had connectivity issues and had to be reset by the technician. The toilet in that room also has poor flushing system leading to clogging after each flush thus we requested a change in room. The new room was much better without any issues and we had comfortable rest inside for our remaining 3 nights. The staff was also thoughtful and helped us to arrange simple breakfast as we had to check out at 430am. Location is within 5mins  walk to Xiaonanmen station and Carrefour and 10mins walk to Ximending. Overall, a recommended hotel in Taipei!

I stay in the hotel with my family, we booked a room with two double beds for three people. The room itself was clean and The furnitures seem relatively new. However, we visited the hotel in July a relatively hot month in Taiwan, The air-conditioning was not working at all, It was too hot for all of us to sleep. When we approach the front desk, they claimed that the entire hotel have the same air condition, in which they claimed they could not help us. The front desk staff attitude was below average. The hotel is not close to any public transport, but if you plan to travel with taxi or Uber, this should not be a matter. The local government given the hotel a five star review. However, in my opinion, it should only be a three star hotel. The bathtub was nice, if we have a working conditioning. I would not consider staying in this hotel a second time.

I opened the quilt and found hair residue. It is understandable that the humidity is high in the mountains, but the bathtub plug in the toilet is broken and has not been repaired. The mold on the side of the bathtub is really unacceptable. The refrigerator in the room does not work at all...

First of all, I would like to recommend Bella Thai Massage next door, which is really great👍
The master is a Thai who can communicate in Chinese. The massage is really good and not expensive

This time I came to Beitou and stayed at Kagaya. Although the hardware facilities are not as good as those in Japan, the service of our ********* is also great!
The CP value is high on weekdays! And you have to stay at least two nights to feel it!
The exhaust fan in the toilet we stayed in on the first night was broken. We didn't notice it and just wondered why the toilet smelled so bad. The next day, we reported it to the front desk and they immediately changed our room to the 15th floor. The room was a little bigger and better.

I felt respected and valued. The only drawback was that the breakfast was really ordinary. . .




Other aspects are good. Although the public pool is not very big, I think it is very good that it lasts until 23:00.

I highly recommend staying in Beitou when you come to Taipei! It's very convenient to go anywhere by MRT

We stayed for two nights. The service at the front desk was good, but the room was a bit old. Fortunately, we were not visiting in the summer, otherwise it would have been extremely hot. There was no air conditioning in the room or it didn't work. The room was very dry and uncomfortable, but it was not hot. The water is sufficient and great for taking a bath

We have recently stayed here for 5 days and 4 nights with my mother and older brother. Our stay here was superb and we availed a room with breakfast buffet. Our room has a city view while the breakfast buffet has a great river view. We loved the view on the breakfast buffet and the breakfast was great too! They served different menu and a lot of varieties on a daily basis. The staff are nice and great too.  They provide free bottled water, coffee, tea and toiletries daily. Upon arrival at the hotel, our room was ready and they let us checked in 2 hours earlier from the original check in time. I think the only con was every after we took our shower, the bathtub sink was clogged.  It will take some time before the water was fully drained. But overall, it was a great stay and just a 10-15mins walk from the center of Ximending/ Ximen Station 6.

Air conditioning not working at night
Dead cockroach in room for 2 days even after tidy up
Shower head is fully covered by mold

The hotel is an old hotel renovated, and the smell of sewerage in the room is very pungent.
The sheets, bath towels, and towels are very worn. The worst thing is that the room does not provide any disposable items or bottled water. In the name of environmental protection, if you want to drink water, you have to walk a long way to the elevator to get water with a kettle, which is outrageous. .
The shower hook in the bathroom cannot be hung. It fell down when taking a shower and hit my feet. The toilet seat is broken and cannot be used. The management is lazy. The hotel looks good. The rooms are like Home Inns. It is rare to encounter rooms with 4 stars. An old hotel, not worth recommending. I feel cheated after booking.
The flush in toilet is intermittent not working properly and the door can't fully open

The toilet was broken and all the water spurted out. I called the hotel and sent a staff member, but he said that we couldn't deal with it since everyone was off work. Then he wiped my door and said that he didn't need to do it, but he Going the extra mile to help us...will not stay here again.

The hotel was abit old but the quality of service provided by the staff is excellent. Specifically, their helpfulness in resolving issues such as a faulty lock on luggage and thr 17th floor staff was try their best to comfort guests during an earthquake, even though they were also concerned themselves. Only that the bathroom is abit inconvenience,  you have to climb in to the bathtub to bath.

It was terrible that there was no prior announcement before the power outage. It was said that the power outage would start at 12 o'clock, and there was no TV to watch at 11 o'clock. It was so stupid. I will never go there again. I was looking forward to taking my family out to play.

The hotel is clean, the environment is comfortable, the staff is polite, the service is good, the toilet light bulb is broken, it was quickly fixed, the buffet breakfast has many styles and the food is delicious. I traveled with my parents this time, and they were also very satisfied 😊
kettle out of order / no hot water in bathroom/ tap hot water flow slow
very nice hotel with good location. Room was clean and toilet is big.  The bidet is not working properly though.

I had an exceptional stay at Cosmos Hotel Taipei! The service was top-notch, and the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort. When our air conditioning wasn't working properly, they quickly resolved the issue by shifting us to a Business Suite the following day - it was a fantastic gesture!

The hotel's 17 Cafe was a great spot, and I loved the free welcome drinks on the house. Plus, they had some unique gifts that made my stay even more special. The location was perfect, just a stone's throw away from Taipei Main Station, making it super convenient for exploring the city.

Overall, I had a fantastic stay at Cosmos Hotel Taipei and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free experience. Five stars isn't enough - I'd give it ten stars if I could!

I requested a quiet room, and they gave me a room where I was truly not bothered by noise for three nights. I have insomnia and am sensitive to noise, so I think being able to get a good night's sleep is important when choosing a hotel for travel. Thank you.
The location directly connected to the station was very helpful during our stay, which was rainy. However, I was surprised by the smell of sewage when entering the hotel from the basement, and by the water leaking from the bottom of the bathtub when I took a shower, although I understand this is unavoidable due to the hotel's aging. I asked the front desk to repair it the next day, but it was disappointing that the leaking did not stop until the end,

The old building has a lot of old facilities, but it seems to be well managed. I called the locals because there was a water leak, and when I came back, they fixed it and it wasn't leaking anymore. They took care of it quickly. It's located a bit of a walk from Simending, so the room size is good for the price. The new building is a bit expensive, but... The view from the breakfast restaurant on the 12th floor is really good. It's literally a river view. Reasonable food, reasonable price.

I think it is a place where you can stay at a cheap price. However, as many people have mentioned, the facilities are very old and poor. When I first visited, the shower hose was broken, so I couldn't wash and had to wait in the room for over an hour, which was inconvenient. It would be good if the facilities were improved a little more. Of course, considering the price, everything makes sense.

We stayed at Hotel Cosmos Taipei with a toddler for 4 nights and had a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

Location:
Perfectly located just a few steps from Exit M3 of Taipei Main Station, making travel within the city very convenient. Restaurants, cafés, and stores are nearby too.

Room:
Spacious, clean, and well-equipped. Despite being opposite the lift, the room was very quiet. It had a Toto toilet, ample storage, and an AI assistant with Bluetooth speaker (though not very responsive). We had a partial view of Taipei Main Station, but the windows were quite dirty.

Breakfast:
Breakfast was decent but limited for vegetarians — mostly fruits, salads, cereals, and a few stir-fried dishes. Labels could be clearer regarding vegetarian options as most dishes contained meat including noodles and pasta. One staff member was quite rude about finishing breakfast by 10 AM, which felt unnecessary, but all others were polite and helpful.

Service & Extras:
Front desk staff were welcoming and friendly. We received complimentary drink coupons for 17 Café and a bath bomb for our toddler — a thoughtful gesture.

Overall:
A great stay overall! Clean, comfortable, and conveniently located. With a few small improvements — like more vegeterian options, better vegetarian labelings and cleaner windows — this hotel could be an excellent choice for anyone visiting Taipei.
