I rarely give review but this time round I feel that I need to write this. We felt warmly welcomed by the manager and staffs upon arrival at the hotel. Pleasantly surprised, we were given a room upgrade which indeed make our stay feel more comfortable especially when it was tough travelling with an active toddler. He has more space to roam. We also able to talk and watch tv without disturbing his sleeps.  Unfortunately,  our toddler had motion sickness from the travel on the first night right after we checked in. The manager did not show any sign of dismay of the mess and instead showed concern on our toddler to make sure he’s ok. We were grateful to the hospitality the hotel has rendered during our stay and highly recommend to our friends and families.  One thing to highlight to the hotel, the water heater in the bathroom is not stable. The temperature fluctuates which nearly scald my toddler during bath.
It's a really nice hotel. It's considered a big hotel in Taipei City. The bed is also moderately soft and hard. The bathroom supplies are also from British brands. Sincerely recommend

The service attitude of the hotel staff is friendly and friendly. The room is bright and bright, the toilet is also super bright, and the facilities are very satisfactory. I highly recommend staying here and will stay again next time.

The hotel room is very big, the bedroom has been renovated and feels comfortable. The bathroom is old, but it is acceptable. The breakfast variety and products are good, and the lobby is large enough with plenty of seats. The only downside is that there is nothing around. You can walk a distance to Liaoning Night Market, and there is also a shuttle bus to the subway station. Overall, it is highly recommended.

The Landis Hotel in Taipei boasts an excellent location with convenient transport links, making it easy to explore the city. The surrounding area is vibrant, filled with a variety of nice restaurants and massage places, perfect for unwinding after a day of sightseeing or business meetings. The hotel itself offers great facilities catering to both business travelers and tourists, ensuring a comfortable and productive stay. Whether you’re in Taipei for work or leisure, The Landis Hotel provides a welcoming and well-equipped base.

The staff were very friendly and helpful.  Excellent location, buffet breakfast with lots of varieties.  Especially like the podium next to the coffee shop, ideal place for kids to run around while the adults were having breakfast!
I recommend staying at this hotel. The room was clean, spacious and the staff are all friendly.
Thank you very much for the hotel upgrade. The service and location are very good! Highly recommend a hotel worth staying in!

The room was clean and there was bed making every day. Although the building itself is old, it felt well cleaned. The unit bath and toilet are in the same space, but there was a partition, which was good to prevent splashing. However, the room I stayed in did not have a door or curtain at the sink area, so I had to be mindful to avoid my father seeing. It would have been nice to have a curtain. The towel bin was replaced daily, but I don't recall there being a toothbrush or pajamas. There was water, coffee, tea leaves, and even carbonated drinks in the refrigerator.

Since my parents were with me, we primarily used taxis, but it was easy to catch one because the main street was right in front. It was nice to be able to walk to Ximending, which was great for evening strolls. There are many SPAs around, so I recommend them.

The station is close, but when wanting to cross the road in front, you have to either go around towards the station or use the overhead bridge on the opposite side. It wasn't particularly inconvenient, but it felt like a detour if you needed to use the bank or ATM across the street. Currency exchange is also possible at the hotel. 

The reception staff kindly provided recommendations about the area and information about currency exchange. My boyfriend stayed in another room, but I was very grateful that we were on the same floor. While walking in the hall, there were times when I could hear voices coming from in front of the rooms, so occasionally you might hear noise from other guests. It wasn’t exceedingly loud during my stay.

My boyfriend had breakfast included, and it seemed nice with a buffet-style featuring various breads and dim sum. There was also a food stall in front of the hotel selling delicious dim sum around lunchtime. 

The drink coupons for the café on the first floor were great because you could choose canned drinks. To the right of the hotel is a FamilyMart and to the left is a 7-Eleven, which is convenient. I recommend the tea egg. I bought toothpaste and found many Japanese products available locally. If you forget cosmetics, there’s a drugstore called Washington past the Mitsukoshi near the station where you can procure them.

Thank you for everything! Overall, it was a comfortable stay, and I hope to visit again.
Awesome hotel highly recommended
Staffs are nice and polite, satisfied with the room with hot spring bathtub, resting  at the balcony after hot spring is so relaxed, recommend to stay here!!!
Great location just off the Red Line.  Easy check in / check out.

Staff knew I booked 2 nights via 2 booking and allow us to stay in the same room instead of checking out and checked in again. Friendly and helpful staff.  Clean and confortable room, toilet bowl looks old. Very good location with shops, eateries, connecting underground to bus terminal, train station. Nearby has family marts, next to departmental store. Recommended.
Excellent location, service is great.

upon check in, i got upgraded from the staff.  When i opened the window, its totally one of the best moment i got for taipei trip. The view is so unbeatable, even i just made plan to come back for new year eve right away .. thank you and see u again soon this December. 💕💕💕

Just like i found hidden gem among hotel in taipei, definitely would recommend this hotel who everyone who want to experience 101 view at night

We had a very pleasant stay at Hotel Royal Beitou during Chinese New Year for 3 nights. First the room was spectacular with a private onsen inside. It was very clean and all the amenities i needed were there. They even had fresh mint leaves for tea. All the staff members were very helpful and polite, they had very good hospitality. The breakfast was adequate, with a range of food that suited everyone's taste. Highly recommend this hotel. I will definitely come back again.

I used it without meals.
The rooms are clean and the service is satisfactory.
It is a hotel that can be recommended for Japanese people as the information is displayed in Japanese. I will use it again when I visit Taipei.

We had a fantastic stay at this hotel. The staff were exceptional and made our experience truly memorable. As we had indicated that our stay was for our honeymoon, they took extra care to decorate the room and gave us small cake as a gift at night.  We had made 2 different room bookings but they had made the transfer easy. The mini private hotspring in the room and breakfast were great as well. Definitely recommended for celebrating special ocassions.

For example, drinks in the room refrigerator can be used for free, there are no toothbrushes in the room, etc. The room quality is good and the service can be upgraded.
Great location for various transportation. Underground passage from airport line a bit far, however walkable. Great breakfast. A bit of sewage smell at toilet area upon entering the room initially.

I will give most recommended hotel in taipei, all staffs are fluent in english and helpful, nice room, clean and quiet with AI helping you to control an electric stuff in room, waking you up with alarm, playing music. The hotel are located in non-crowded area and safe neighborhoods. waking just like 5-10 minutes from mrt green line xionanmen station.
very bad experience stay 3 nights in this hotel, to get good recommendation unless this hotel reconstruction and retraining their employees.

I really enjoyed while I am staying there. Lady at the reception speaks English fluently  was so kind and provide best service. All facilities was helpful to be relaxed. Highly recommended and will stay here again for the next visit.

We truly enjoyed our time here . The hotel is old but the upkeep is good. It felt like going back in time and we felt very special staying here . Their buffet was delicious  too. Thoroughly enjoyed it and would recommend to anyone visiting Taipei - even if you live here like ourselves 😊
Close to the train station, room is clean and the service is excellent. Highly recommended

This hotel is located within walking distance to the MRT. Very accessible to travelers. Even within walking distance to Ximending shopping street/night market. 

The staff are friendly and helpful. 

The rooms are kept clean. 

Would recommend!

The hotel is very convenient. It is right opposite Xinbeitou Station. When checking in, the staff introduced the facilities in the room very carefully. The private hot spring is very comfortable and convenient. The hot spring on the 12th floor is also very spacious. Overall, this hot spring trip is very good. satisfy! ￼Highly recommended￼

This was our second stay. During our previous trip, my husband couldn't join us, so I wanted him to experience this hotel as well, which is why I chose it again. This time we weren't on a tour, so we had to get around by ourselves, but the Grand Hotel Taipei has a great location, a shuttle bus, and it was easy and affordable to take a taxi to the city center, which was nice. After sightseeing, even when we returned tired, we had a clean and beautiful room with a bathtub, which was also great. Many of the staff members spoke Japanese and were kind and attentive.

We booked a family room (Grand Deluxe Family Room) with three beds (one king, two singles) at a special rate so it was good value for money. The room was excellent all round except the carpet could do with modernising - a minor issue. Highly recommend if you can get a good deal

We loved this hotel! Clean and classy place with a view of Taipei 101 from our window. Room was very large with a beautiful large bathroom. King-sized bed was very comfortable with the best pillows we've ever had at a hotel. We had an early flight and they were so nice to have a bagged breakfast to go waiting for us at reception! Central location to take taxis everywhere around the city. Highly recommended this hotel!
Great location and excellent breakfast!

Hotel is impressive! You can’t miss it when you’re in Taipei.
Rooms are very worn out, they should be better maintained. It is a bit saddening to come up to such a wonderful place and feel like it is missing something,
Service at the reception is far from the standards of 5*. Staff should have better training.
Doormen are kind and helpful.
I’d still recommend for a stay in Taipei but keep in mind that it’s quite inconvenient to visit the centre of the city.
Hotel is location is center, close to Metro station, room is spacious. Value for money. One negative feedback is Wi-Fi is slow

Great property in a good location with a mall and MRT nearby.  The staff’s service was top notch making our stay truly enjoyable.  The value for money was unbeatable, providing a fantastic experience.  Highly recommended!
The hotel is in a great location, close to the Taipei subway station. I will book again next time. The hotel service is very good. The breakfast meets my needs. My children love it.

The room is large and clean. I booked a buffet dinner for the New Year's Eve dinner because it was the Spring Festival. The food was rich and delicious. The hotel also gave a baby elephant as a New Year gift. The service, especially the security guard at the entrance of the lobby, was very kind and always greeted guests with warm smiles. It was a great pleasure to check in. Feel more friendly when you stay, the drinks and snacks in the room are free of charge, recommended

The hotel boasts an excellent location, offering incredible convenience for exploring and getting to any destination. The breakfast spread was extensive, varied, and truly delicious. Moreover, the rooms were very quiet and spotlessly clean.

It was conveniently located in the city center, near the MRT station. I checked in after a late flight, but there were no issues at all, and all the staff were kind. They also happily assisted with restaurant reservations and luggage storage after check-out. The facilities were not particularly old, and there was a washlet as well. I highly recommend it if you don't mind not being right in front of Taipei Station.
Friendly and great location, perfect for tourists travelling with young kids.

The hotel is very comfortable and the environment is very clean. The location of the hotel is very convenient. The hotel staff are very polite and made me feel a different journey. I will definitely recommend this hotel again next time.

The room is very big and old, the shower equipment is very old, the carpet is very messy, the sofa is full of fleas and bites, it is not recommended to stay here, the house price is fickle and deceptive, they say there is only one room left, but the room is gone as soon as I place the order. There is one room, and it’s cheap, so cool😡
Great location with friendly staff. The room is clean

nice hotel… highly recommended and worth the price…. 👌👌👌👌👌

Great stay and love that there is refillable sparkling water on each floor to refill your bottles/bottle hotel provides during stay. Locations is also easy to catch the airport train! Highly recommend

Excellent location, sumptuous breakfast and good amenities. We got early check-in right at our arrival . The front desk staffs are very kind and helpful.
This room rate is very good value for the hotel's facilities and services! recommend!
Excellent location with convenient transportation access.

I've stayed at very nice hotels and this is at the top of the list. From the breakfast buffet to the giant rooms, this place is top notch. Great location with departmental stores near the hotel. The staffs were able to arrange a baby cot for my 10 months old and they try their best to accommodate to our requests of putting two guest rooms side by side. However we noticed that not all rooms came with a bath tub.

Friendly service staff

Great location and the staff are very nice and helpful. We ordered room services and the restaurants in the hotel were great as well.

They spend a lot of money on their doormen and how the property looks, but not enough on staff training and functional upkeep.

I DO enjoy their gym a lot, but at the cost of giving up that luxury, I think I will stay at a nearby hotel with a lot less starts the next time.  THEY have great reviews.

We recently stayed at Cosmo Taipei Hotel and while the location is undeniably convenient—just a few meters from the M3 gate of Taipei Main Station—our overall experience left much to be desired.

To start with the positives, the location is central and well-connected. Though our original room faced the main road, we were pleasantly surprised by the soundproofing; traffic noise was barely noticeable. The gym was also a plus, as it was empty during our stay, offering privacy.

However, the negatives significantly overshadowed these points. The most frustrating issue was the air-conditioning. We booked a family room for four, and despite the aircon being on for over five hours, the room remained uncomfortably warm—more like a sauna than a hotel room. After calling the front desk, a technician came and merely adjusted the vent angle, claiming it needed more time to cool. It never did. We endured two sleepless, sweaty nights before requesting a room change. The front desk staff helped us move to a room one level down and even admitted that the central air-conditioning system across the hotel is generally weak. Thankfully, the new room was slightly better, and we finally experienced some relief.

Another disappointing incident occurred on the 2nd day while we were still in the original "sauna room." I had left my personal card in the slot to keep the air running for ventilation (something I usually wouldn’t do, but in this case, the room badly needed it). When we returned, the card was gone. I contacted the reception, and said he couldn't reach housekeeping and would update me the next morning. When I followed up peronally as no one gotten back to me, I was told no one had taken the card. I ended up checking with a kind housekeeping auntie myself—who wasn’t even the one assigned to our room the previous day—and she found my card in the storeroom. To make matters worse, the reception implied that the card may not have been slotted in at all, essentially trying to shift the blame back to me. Truly disappointing service.

Lastly, the room condition itself was below expectations. For a family of four, the space was extremely cramped and the furnishings looked worn and outdated. Movement was restricted, and the overall comfort level was far from what one would expect for the price.

All in all, while Cosmo Taipei Hotel offers a great location, the air-conditioning issue, poor service recovery, and outdated room conditions make it hard for me to recommend this hotel—especially for families.

The hotel provides a clean room, very comfortable environment and fantastic service during my 10 days day.  I highly recommend other visitors to Taipei to choose this hotel for their stay.  Considering it’s a 5 star hotel, the price it charges is very reasonable.

Very grand architecture, spacious room, well decked amenities (constantly replenished), helpful staff, good size heated outdoor pool, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi and gym. Location is good too, walking distance to metro and shopping centre. Was a very luxuoius and comfortable stay, at reasonable pricing! Highly recommend others to stay here too.
Great stay for families and great location with big rooms

[Location: Best]
The location is connected underground to Taipei Main Station M6 exit, so you can go anywhere comfortably.
Ximending, Huashan 1914, Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hall, and Ningxia Night Market can also be reached within 20 minutes.
Convenient facilities such as Starbucks, department stores, and Watsons are also close by, so it's the best if you value distance.

However, the facility is an old building, so the bathrooms such as bathtubs are old and very humid. I couldn't even open the window, so I was a bit stuffy.

I recommend it if you only look at the distance, but it was somewhat disappointing in terms of facilities. The service was so kind.

Best experience money can buy. From alighting to entering the room, everything is smooth and pleasant. 

Ordering room service food isn’t exactly the best however. It’s rather pricey and for that price, I’d Recommend to ordering FoodPanda etc.
Staff are courteous and very accommodating to every request. Breakfast buffet superb. Cleanliness of the room ok. Definitely will come back again and recommend to relative and friends

The best hotel to watch the Little Arena concert. It's directly off the MRT at Nanjing Fuxing Station. It's super convenient. The breakfast is delicious. There are set meals and all-you-can-eat options. The room is clean and the price is reasonable. It's worth recommending.

The hotel is old but is well managed with modern era renovations.
It is located at a strategic point on the subway.
Very clean place, and most importantly (No smookinge smell) in the rooms!
Breakfast "is a little weak" but meets basic needs.
Parking is chaotic, you have to wait for spaces.
But in general, I recommend it to everyone!
Lovely hotel that is value for money, very clean and staff are friendly and helpful. The location is a bit far from the shopping area of Taipei. There are 2 bus stops nearby though.
Overall, good value for money. Staff were great! Hotel is clean. And price good. The interiors are old though, and at the edge (not inside) of Ximending shopping district.

I chose Santos hotel because all its rooms have windows. I got a regular sized hotel room with 2 twin beds, Location not in a busy part of town which is ok. . Hotel is not new but the room was clean, sheets and towels were pristine white. Generous with bottled water, coffee, tea in sachets. Staff were very helpful. Carpet can do with shampooing. Bedskirt needs to be replaced. A 5-10 min walk to the train station, very convenient. From the airport I took the bus, got off across the hotel and just walked short distance. Took bus going back to airport. Was able to go to bus stn via the train. Pics show view from my window and bus trip sched.They serve buffet meals. I would recommend this hotel for these reasons.
Great location, good service, housekeeping very friendly and helpful, will come back again and again

Excellent location of very close to M3 exit from MRT, this will facilitate your transportation and save your time and energy. Well-equipped standard room with cleanliness.  Delicious breakfast  with variety. Thank you.
Great location and staff
Great location and clean.  Good hotel service and close to subway.
Friendly staff. Large room. Central location. Efficient service. Nice breakfast. Make a rather enjoyable stay for us. Highly recommended.

Room and bathroom were clean and well maintained, but a bit too small and ctamp for 2 travellers sharing the room.  Not much space for luggage.  Hotel overall dining options were good and convient to casual eating places and convenience store.  Would recommend for single traveller more, good rate and good room.

Excellent location just across Taipei Main Station. Exit M3 just beside hotel entrance. Though hotel decor is old fashioned but I think the rooms have been renovated or well maintained (at least the room we were in). Clean bedsheets and towels with Japanese bidet toilet and ample supply of bottled drinking water with you can get from friendly cleaning staff. You will also find some amenities like shoe horn, shoe mint and lint duster which is now seldom found in newer hotels.
A really good location next to a main station. Room was spacious and beautiful. Concierge staff, Ken, helped us a lot and he was very nice and kind. Highly recommend.
It's a bit far from Ximen Station, but it's a good value hotel.
service is very good and location is great. highly recommend
Excellent location. Good quality shampoo/lotion/conditioner.

The hotel is very grand, the room is large and comfortable, if you bring a suitcase, you can open it completely, but the location is a bit far from the Ximending MRT station, it is not convenient to drag the luggage over, there are two disadvantages about the room
1. If the air conditioner is turned off, what about the ventilation system coming in from the door? The sound of running water is very loud, and the air conditioner has to be turned on to wind speed 1 to completely cover it. This sound of running water is annoying all day long, and it is impossible to deal with it.
2. The soundproofing is very poor. Not only can you hear the chatter in the corridor, but you can also hear the snoring of the residents next door. It is recommended that the front desk provide earplugs

Although it is a many-year-old hotel, it is very clean! The two single beds are comfortable to sleep on, and there is a bathtub 🛁 where you can take a bath and rest, which is nice 👍! Highly recommended!
Its an old hotel. But for the price i paid i  cannot complain. They have clean good spacious rooms. Its peaceful and quiet. And free breakfast. I would gladly recommend it. Its value for money.
Very good value for money 👍

Very festive decorations at lobby for Christmas.
Check in was easy and quick. Room was clean with all toiletries provided, spacious too! Location wise not that near the metro station but was easy to travel around using Uber. Pool was good with a lap pool and separate jacuzzi pool which heated water, great Taipei 101 view from pool area.  Housekeeping service was hit and miss at some points though overall service was excellent ! Will recommend staying here

The location is good. There are many restaurants near 101. However, the customer service of the hotel staff is poor. It is recommended to choose other hotels for the same price. It completely ruined the experience of the family anniversary. I will not stay here again and strongly do not recommend it.
This hotel provides full range of gym equipments and sauna facilities with sky view swimming pool which is perfect if you are planning for a relaxing trip, highly recommended.

Once we opened the door to our room we were amazed by the decor and size of the room, along with an automated welcome greet by the hotels Alexa. Felt very welcomed and appreciated the stay.
The restroom was out of this world !!!
Shower room attached with a traditional Japanese type stone bath tub which made showering more relaxed and comfortable after a long days travel. 
Strongly recommended. The staff was very friendly and showed great service on the hospitality they provided.

The handsome guy at the front desk was super nice. He helped us check in more than an hour in advance. He also helped us refrigerate the cakes that needed to be refrigerated. They had already put our luggage in the room when we checked in. Super thoughtful and detailed. The lobby on the first floor is not a service desk. You need to go to the sixth floor. Hotel toiletries need to be picked up on the sixth floor. The room is older but very clean. The pillows are a little soft. Because the weather has not been very cold recently, the water temperature is not bad. It was pretty good after that. I stayed at Kagaya before and it was very Japanese-style. I think each of the two houses is different. There is a seafood restaurant behind the hotel🦞The hotpot is called Hotpot Shijia. It is super recommended to order seafood. It’s great👏There is also a snack Michelin store worth visiting every two months. It has a light taste and must be eaten with light soy sauce and chili sauce. Will come again, thank you.
great location and service. we enjoyed the small touches like a sparkling water dispenser on every floor and the variety of equipment in the gym
Super highly recommended! Location is excellent, just besides Taipei Main Station!  Staff are very accomodating! Very clean room and facilities! Love it!

I stayed here for three nights in April. It was clean, the staff were friendly, and the room was spacious and comfortable. The breakfast was especially delicious and clean. The pool, while small, was well-maintained and satisfying. However, the location was a bit far from the MRT, so taking a taxi was the most convenient option. I highly recommend it for families traveling with seniors or children.

The most convenient hotel. Shopping and good restaurants are very close. The scenery is first-class. The swimming pool is 20 to 25 meters long. The hotel front desk staff has first-class service. The cleaning staff also has first-class service. It is the best hotel in Taipei. The pastas in Italian restaurants are also delicious. Recommend the bar’s beef noodles and truffle fries🍟

The service is great (including check in/out, taking seats, storing luggage...etc.)
Music in the lobby (6/8) The piano performance in the morning was great!
"Mi Dao Bar" is very relaxing. The waiters will take care of the guests' ideas when introducing catering, bartending, etc. The recommended wine is also very delicious, and the service is nice)
It was really good to explore the East Secret Road at night, the welcome drinks were very attentive, and the staff (including security) were also very polite.
The room is spacious and clean, with a view of Dajia Riverside Park and 101.
Something to note: The shower drains slowly.

Convenient location near a big market and Ximending St., kind staffs, clean rooms, and high water pressure in the rooms. One of the rooms had fungi smell but no window to open to ventilate though. Okay breakfast buffet, and offer free snack bags upon check-in. Recommended.

Thanks to the excellent service and amenities of this hotel our first time in Taipei was very memorable and special. The breakfast was amazing, the room was very clean and the all the staff was amazing. The executive lounge staff, Lydia, Angelina and Rachel very all very friendly and gave us many recommendations for our trip. Next time we are in Taipei we will definitely be staying again.

We booked early at a fantastic price, but the hotel still exceeded my expectations.  There is no hotel in a better location than this, with this level of hygiene, service level that doesn't cost a lot more. We will be recommending this place to everyone we know.

I arrived a little before 1:30 and they checked if a prepared room was available, so I could check in early! 

The room was spacious and clean, and above all, having a bathtub was really nice. The bed was quite comfortable, and there were a lot of people busking outside Taipei 101, which made it very noisy, but the soundproofing was good! 
I also checked out the pool in the evening, and not many people were getting in the water; most were taking pictures, haha. 
It was a bit disappointing that the room didn’t have a Taipei 101 view, but all the staff were friendly, the location is good, and I recommend it!
Excellent location, good facilities. Upgraded service, great experience.
This hotel near Taipei main station. The location have family mart and 7-11. Highly recommended.
During the living period, I felt so cozy and comfortable. The location is so convenient for traveler, recommended!

This was an excellent stay and I highly recommend it. The hotel itself is slightly dated, but is incredibly comfortable, very clean, and has excellent facilities. The room was comfortable with a nice view. I recommend opting for a room with the breakfast buffet. The food was absolutely incredible, and the buffet hall where it is served has an incredible wrap around view of the city and the river. Absolutely worth a stay here! If I go back to Taipei I will stay here again.
Hotel is old but clean, Great location, just next to the MRT. Breakfast is average but you can choose buffet at 13th floor or set American breakfast at ground floor. good choice of food around hotel.

The hotel is located in downtown Xin Beitou and close to many restaurant and the MRT station. The facility is clean overall and breakfast was great! There's a private onsen in the room as well as a public one. The staff is really friendly and helpful.
Would recommend for the location and if you are into old-timey Japanese style. 
That said, I think the price is still a little high for the value. Best to go when there's promotion.
Great location, delicious breakfast, great service, highly recommended
Always been my 1st choice for my biz trip.  Excellent location with great food in the  vicinity.
Cleanliness is top notch. Room is spacious and comfortable. Very well kept condition and AI is fun. Highly recommended!
Very convenient location. Close to shops and public transport. Friendly staff and efficient service.

Wonderful stay with very neat environment 
I went during xmas and the hotel was well decorated with a big xmas tree and Santa Clause to take photos with
Restaurants in hotel are also fantastic except they are quite fully booked
In general, we would love to return to the hotel next time
Used the pool and gym! Friendly staff. Bedrooms and comfy and clean!

I stayed here because it was close to the venue where my favorite artist is performing live, and it was the first time in a while that I was so satisfied with a hotel.
All of the hotel staff were wonderful and I had a pleasant stay.
I would like to stay here again if I have the opportunity.
It was also convenient that the limousine bus from Taoyuan Airport stops right in front of the hotel.
The breakfast wasn't quite to my taste, but the calm, dignified room was a relaxing space to relax in.
I was also glad that they responded immediately to a problem I had (I didn't know how to drain the water from the bathtub).
Wonderful stay at the hotel. The staff are friendly. The housekeepers are very diligent and friendly.
The room is clean and spacious. The facility is newly renovated. Friendly staff and very good breakfast.
My family enjoyed the stay at Taipei Garden Hotel. Rooms were affordable, spacious and clean! Also loved how convenient it was to walk to the nearest train station.
Enjoyed our stay there!
Very accommodating & friendly staff. Clean and very comfortable.

Full sevice hotel at a great price point and location. We enjoyed our stay! Only grouse was the awkward shower door that made it difficult to shower for my kid. The welcome drink at their cafe was a bonus, very nice surprise that we didn't expect! Breakfast area was crowded and you wait a little longer if you prefer not to share a table with anyone.

How many hotels have been operating in Taipei for over 50 years amidst the waves of this tumultuous era? The Grand Hotel evokes memories of the good old days with its classic atmosphere. The inclusion of breakfast in the accommodation fee is reminiscent of the once-kind Taiwanese style. The breakfast was quite simple but included warm dishes, and I enjoyed it very much. It provides a sense of nostalgia that you won't find in the latest functional hotels. The mattress on the bed was hard, which I personally preferred.
Friendly staff, good location and spacious room, would have been perfect if there is a swimming pool or rooftop garden and bar for night view.

The hotel is conveniently located next to the MRT, making it easy to get around. The amenities include a gym, swimming pool, and Japanese bath, which enhance the overall experience. The staff are friendly and helpful, contributing to a pleasant stay. Our room had a comfortable king-size bed, and despite facing a busy street, it was quiet at night thanks to the soundproof windows.
This place is good place to stay, friendly staff.

Thoroughly love this hotel! Second home in Taipei! Located in the heart of Xinyi  shopping district with plenty of food choices, movie theatre, shopping and pubs around the hotel! Friendly staffs and cleanliness is tip top. Definitely will be my first choice of hotel to stay in Taipei Taiwan!

We definitely enjoyed our stay in this hotel.
Location was good, a fruit stand and the supermarket were nearby. Rooms were very spacious, they had free snacks, they had the Japanese style bidet and bathtub. 
The only thing we did not like is the see through glass in the bathroom where you can still see the person seated on the toilet. Not a very good sight to see and not friendly if you are sharing a room with friends or even family members. We suggest that they at least put a dry wall even half way through if the concern is for security. 
Overall this hotel is one of the best we have stayed in.

Taipei Main Station location is convenient and good to go anywhere
Friendly staff, quick check-in and check-out, clean room
A little musty smell in the hallway, but no problem
breakfast normal
Friendly staffs, nice and big room, good location. Enjoyed staying
enjoyed my booking here. Very clean and amenities were great. Their breakfast is also veey good
Hotel rooms are very clean and kids enjoyed staying in there. There’s an onsen bathtub in the room so perfect for kids!

Excellent hotel. Good location.
Well maintained and newly renovated.
Overall I enjoyed the stay.

Centrally located, next to Taipei Main Station, with MRT intersection, High Speed Rail (including airport link), buses and loads of tourist bus meets, this hotel is compact but clean, well priced and friendly staff. With a welcome drink card, a happy hour drink card and decent breakfast spread, it makes up for the compact rooms and lack of free water refilling station (though you do get a fresh bottle of water each day). I would definitely stay here again if in Taiwan, as the coffee downstairs is good, and there is a both a Family Mart and 7 Eleven either side, as well as a hole in the wall eatery that does pretty good cooked snacks.

Every staff we met since MRT pickup is super friendly and diligent in helping us with taxi arrangement, room service, and others.  Kids had a lot of fun enjoying the spring and swimming pools  while adults enjoyed public and room onsen very much!  Definitely will come back for more stays.
Perfect location, super clean and professional staff. I had a pleasant stay!
The hotel's breakfast buffet was first-rate and delicious. The rooms were spacious, and I really enjoyed the water dispensers on each floor, where you can make your own sparkling water.
It was so convenient and awesome ~pleasant staying ~thank you😘
Modern hotel that is near the train station… enjoyed having our own spa tub

Taken from its original branch, it is not difficult to see that Kagaya has succeeded its good service and mode of hot spring for the visitors to enjoy.

There are quite some small details that I enjoyed and haven't experienced in Japan. There are assigned dedicated lockers when you do onsen, so you can be sure that you will have a locker when you go in. There is a bottle of water inside the locker so to make sure you are hydrated.

The SPA service can be improved as my mother and I have experienced it. The service is good nonetheless.

Near the hotel, there are a number of restaurants that one can enjoy every day.

On top of that, their breakfast is also pretty nice.
Friendly staff, great breakfast spread, nice pool, spacious room.  Price reasonable.
Rooms are spacious and location is good. There is a big supermarket nearby.  It was a pleasant stay with the family.

Location: 15 minute walk away from Ximenting area, it was a fairly accessible hotel with the metro station a short walk away. As a family of 4 (children 11 and 6), however, we took Ubers / Taxis most places. 

There is a Carrefour across the road, which was convenient. Family mart and 7-11 are a 5 minute walk away. 

The hotel is comfortable, clean and well appointed. Furnishings appeared new and very functional. The bed was firm and comfortable. They even had an voice controlled AI that the kids enjoyed trying to use to control the room functions. 

All guests are giving a small plastic bag to collect local snacks and candy (and drinks!) from a store just outside the hotel lobby - a unique and enjoyable perk. 

Overall, a good hotel to use as a base to explore Taipei and its surroundings.

We all enjoyed it.
Good location, good room service as its highly grand hotel.

A pleasant surprise…food n MRT nearby. Friendly staff and fairly sizeable rooms. Quality of beds and chairs in question…just needs updating. But hotel is generally clean ( unless some repairs are being undertaken ). Thumbs up.

Quite surprised with the hotel room and facilities... very big and clean.. hot spring tub very comfortable.. breakfast also very nice.. everything is good and friendly staffs…. Will stay again for next taiwan visit..
Very comfortable stay! Really enjoyed ourselves in Taipei.
Brother hotel has great services clean room and friendly staff.   Location is perfect.

Very nice hotel. We enjoyed  the pool and the sauna (women and men seperated). The breakfast buffet was very good. We even tried some food we never ate before. Staff was very helpful, friendly and they all spoke English.
Location is very good. The front desk staffs and housekeeping staffs are friendly. It was a pleasant stay.

Been to the onsen resort in JApan before, this time, it is a totally similar experience with wonderful and relaxing Onsen and friendly staff. My mom and I had some relaxing moments. The environment around the area is beautiful too.

We had a pleasant stay. Bright and quite recently renovated room.
Will stay again if I return.

Big room with a big bed, relatively clean and friendly staff. Super good location. The only downside were :(1) too dark as many has reviewed the same (2) the big bath tub is dangerous to step in and out. Definitely a no-no for old people. (3!) No coin laundry but nearby has a good laundry shop.
Excellent room with private pool. Had a wonderful stay. Staff were also great. We had both dinner and breakfast at the hotel but food wasn’t great.

Location is good. Breakfast spread is good.
Had a pleasant stay.

we checked inn -the room is big and spacious with nice view I can work with that WiFi with tub it’s clean everyday I love the bed I enjoyed the coffee complete amenities I want to go back there it was near the shopping area ximending so cool
I really enjoyed my stay. It was very relaxing. Thank you

It was a trip for my three daughters and three mothers~ We had a lot of trouble deciding which hotel to go to in Taipei, but we chose this hotel considering the location and facilities. The breakfast was especially delicious, and we enjoyed using the pool and sauna all three days~

The hotel is close to Taipei main station which is convenient. Room is clean and well maintained. Hotel staff are friendly and helpful too. We enjoyed our stay and will definitely choose this hotel when we are back in Taipei.
Overall a pleasant stay. The snack options in the executive lounge could’ve been better.

having a hot tub in the room was such a plus

my kids were there 2 christmases ago. They enjoyed their stay so much we decided to come and check it out too. 

good location
excellent breakfast buffet
courteous staff

Grand Hyatt Taipei is a lovely hotel, centrally located near shopping belt and Taipei 101. Clean rooms, friendly staff and a restaurant which serves up an international breakfast buffet. Just two areas of improvement compared to other Hyatts globally. The restaurant serves up rice but lacks proper table spoons and though there is electric bidet in the room toilets, they place the spare toilet rolls a distance away at the sink. Other than these, it’s a beautiful hotel!
Enjoyed the cafe and small shop selling souvenirs right outside the hotel. Near Taipei station and so everything is convenient.  Room is clean and the staff service is awesome.

Though the room we have does not have any window I would say it was still a pleasant stay, very clean and the staff are all very polite. The buffet is a bit steep for what they have to offer according to my local friend who came to visit me. The shuttle is a plus to go around. You just have to know the schedule.
Love love this hotel, definitely coming back whenever I’m visiting Taipei. Centrally located, clean, safe, and friendly staff!

I booked a suite for the family and was able to obtain lounge access during our stay. This hotel is located at the heart of Taipei and right across the street from a metro station, very convenient (although we mainly use taxi due to the hot weather). The room is very nice and quiet. We also had the chance to use the pool that needs to be reserved in advance. The pool only had two lanes so it can get crowded when there are many people in there but we had fun regardless.

This hotel also has several restaurants. We had dinner once in the Chinese restaurant downstairs and the food was delicious. We also had breakfast buffet every day in a different restaurant downstairs, which also served a variety of quality foods. Both places are very popular and always packed. 

We really enjoyed their lounge that offers snacks and a light dinner. The staff in this hotel are all very friendly and professional. We will definitely stay at this hotel again!
Very accomodated and friendly staff..☺️

Hotel location is good, 2 mins walk from exit M3 of Taipei main station.
Friendly staff.

I recently stayed at your hotel and overall had a comfortable experience. The breakfast was delightful, especially the fresh and tasty salad—it was a highlight! The hotel’s environment and location are also great, offering convenience and a pleasant atmosphere.  

However, there are a few areas that could be improved. The facilities feel somewhat outdated, though they were still functional. Additionally, while most staff were courteous, one gentleman at the front desk seemed less welcoming—a more consistent level of hospitality would enhance the guest experience.  

Lastly, the check-in and check-out times felt quite restrictive. Earlier check-in and later check-out options would make stays more convenient for guests.  

Despite these points, I enjoyed my time here and would consider returning. With some adjustments, this could be an even better stay!

I love the free activities provided by the hotel. 

I enjoyed the night walk tour organized by the hotel and the yoga classes. Hope they would continue to organize the free yoga classes ( although it is only 30 min, it is good for the trip) relaxing , thx

Pros: - Can't argue with the location - All your shopping needs can be fulfilled at the mall downstairs - Friendly staff Cons: - By design, no separation between dressing, bathroom and sleeping quarters - Also by design, two sliding doors blocking the wardrobe and minibar/fridge areas means that you could access them only one at a time, but not both - Bathroom facilities was less than ideal (difficult to get the bathtub to drain, shower's response to temperature settings less than ideal) - The lighting controls were unintuitive - Emphasis on conservation probably led to missing tea/coffee packets and empty shower gel in the latter days of our stay
Very friendly staff, and the room is nice and clean.
My husband and I enjoyed our stay at the Grand hotel in Taipei very much. The room was clean and tidy, and the staff were very nice! We will definitely go back again in the future!
Enjoyed our trip very much.

We just came back from Taipei and spent 5 nights at Taipei Garden Hotel and it was a pleasant stay for us. The hotel is clean and spacious, breakfast spread is good, location wise is good as well as walking 3mins to Careffour and jus 5mins drive to ShI Lin night market. Train station is just 5mins walk. 

We will come back again if visit Taipei again.
Pleasant Stay At Pleasant Hotel

The location of this hotel is around 10 to 15mins walk to Ximending area and  Ximen MRT station.  
The staffs are very accommodating and very helpful. Thank you.:)
My family enjoyed the snack bar as they were able to try different snacks in Taipei. 
The buffet breakfast spread is quite nice too, would be best if there will be scrambled egg station.hehe
Overall, if I will be back in Taipei, I would definitely book this hotel again. 
Thank you  to all the Staffs especially the ones stationed at the luggage area/taxi booking assistance.
It was a pleasant experience with a good buffet breakfast spread. The hotel provides complimentary candy bar that the kids enjoyed and daily bottled water. Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Extremely convenient location for travelers that need to take public transportation to other places in Taiwan. Great welcome drinks that offer fresh squeezed juices, friendly staffs and clean places. The room is a bit small but cannot ask for more at the heart of the city center.
We enjoyed our stay at the Cosmos Hotel.
Friendly staff and budget-friendly
Pleasant stay and right beside mrt station - fully sheltered walk. Service was also exceptional.
Friendly staff. Will stay again.
Friendly staff and comfortable room

nice stay.
friendly staff.
Friendly staff, super good service and good location

Good room size and convenient access to transportation (within 10 minutes walk).  Cery friendly staff.  However, cleanliness and amenities could be improved.  The shower room does not have a place to put shower gel or shampoo items.

We really enjoyed our stay there. The staff were very professional. The room was clean, comfortable, and quiet. All the room amenities were all very high quality. The breakfast buffet offered a great variety of food and everything was delicious (especially the Japanese mochi).  The hotel is located in a central location, close to MTR station, with a lot of shopping nearby.

No matter the facilities, sanitation level, staff service, etc. are up to the standard of a five-star hotel, this is the second time I have stayed here. The last time I stayed for one day, I felt it was not enough. This time I chose to stay for two days. This time I am really more satisfied than last time🤗, you can enjoy the hot spring equipment in the room.

Last time we enjoyed the food in the western restaurant and felt that it was very standard. This time we chose the two set meals at the Chinese restaurant Yong Cui Ting. Although it is a Chinese restaurant, the food is still more Western-style, but it is still very high-quality, which made us very happy There is a surprise 👍, compared to the fine dining of Western food, it is more filling.

Breakfast is included in the room rate. On the first day, we chose a table-style breakfast. Unexpectedly, passengers who stay for more than one day can choose not only ********* and vegetarian dishes, but also Western-style breakfast. Of course we chose Western-style breakfast, which is also very good.

it's a 5 star hotel however staff is not trained to meet its level. The front desk had difficulty identifying my reservation due to name change. Also, she cannot explain the difference between a mountain view and a street view rooms. Due to weather issues (incoming typhoon), unfortunately we had to use the slippers for outdoor activities. Anyway, we returned them back within 2 hours after checked out. I don't believe this is the service a 5 star hotel would provide. it's not a pleasant stay overall..
Friendly staff, always helpful. Breakfast is good. Very satisfied with the offer of being up-graded .
Spacious room and friendly staff. Clean rooms
very attentive and friendly staff, location of hotel is convenient as it is located near a convenience stall and the Taipei main station
2nd time staying here and its always the best value added place. Friendly staff at breakfast buffet, dated but has everything you need.
Had a pleasant stay and the hotel is very conveniently located next to M3 exit of Taipei main station which I found very convenient to take the MRT.

Room booked was meant to face Taipei 101, but it was too close - hence the viewing experience is subpar. W Hotel would have a better viewing experience. 

Breakfast spread is quite good! You need to try it. We enjoyed our breakfast.

We had lunch at Bel Air, service and decoration was excellent. Food wise, it wasn’t anything special at an exorbitant price. But you pay for the ambience and service.

Rooms are comfy and we slept very well.  We loved the separate shower and bath tub.

Gym is well equipped. The sauna is very comfortable, but the pool is a little tiny.
Good facility, nice breakfast and friendly staff
We had booked two rooms for our family and enjoyed the stay. Hotel is convenient with public transportation.
Friendly staff and clean hotel
Enjoyed our stay. Fantastic location and staff was fantastic.

Friendly staff with good attitude
The place is clean and the room is spacious

Overall, I enjoyed my stay there very much. Rooms and views are nice, linens fresh. Free sparkling water and Nespresso in the rooms. Breakfast buffet great. Location super convenient. 

However, given the room rates I was disappointed about:
1) Number of disposable items such as plastic bottles and amenity kits.
2) Humidity - the AC had to be set to very cold for the room not to be humid. 
3) Basic in-room dining menu, lack of vegetarian options.
4) Pool serving drinks in thing, disposable plastic containers. Just why disposable?!

It is just next to the Taipei MRT station exit M3. 
Very helpful and friendly staff.
Overall experience is great with friendly staff.  Location a bit far, but they have provide the shuttle service to pick up and drop off. If have any chance, I will come back again.
Enjoyed the in-room hot spring after visiting and hiking YMS.
Hotel is nice and clean.  Grest hot spring, deliciouse and splended breakfast, friendly staff.  Had a nice stay and great time.

This was our place when we stayed for five nights in Ximending. About 10 mins. walk to everything! We had a pleasant stay. The room we got has another room for the two beds so it was amazing! A big room for both of us.  The front desk staff was also very helpful in all of our concerns.
Spend a week here. Very good place to stay and not far away from MRT station. Friendly staff and 7-11 just beside! Really enjoyed my stay here

We enjoyed this hotel because the rooms are spacious, the toiletries smell so good, the location is just next M3 exit of Taipei Main Station. It is a few steps away from the Klook's group tour meet-up at E3. They have a nice cafe and the restaturant nearby serves yummy beef noodles and pork buns
easy access and friendly staff

Love the coffee provided in the hotel room! It can be purchased in their cafe. 

Overall the room and towel is clean and tidy. Staffs are friendly and helpful. The hotel location is very near to exit M3 and M7 of Taipei Main metro station (around 5mins walk). Overall, we enjoyed the stay here!

My friend really enjoyed his stay in Grand Hotel.
He also said the room was super clean and service was great.

Front desk is really friendly and everything is perfect . We really enjoyed the breakfast they offer many food including Chinese and western style especially some local food which are really delicious . 
We got a really big and clean room . Swimming pool are really clean my partner really enjoyed the sauna . 
If we come back to visit Taipei again we definitely gonna book again to stay in Miramar ~~
Very central, friendly staff helped us with lots of travel tips and transport arrangements. Breakfast was okay, pool wasn’t as big as we thought but still had a great time using it.
Pleasant stay. Amazing location next to mrt station.
Well located hotel, next to a mall and steps away from train and bus stations. Breakfast buffet was adequate. Overall a pleasant stay.

Location was good and friendly staff.

1. The air conditioner in the room is noisy. 2. The room is full of a strong smell of ozone. 3. Treat guests differently. We sat together in the lobby drinking beer, but enjoyed different treatment. We had a very comfortable stay and our children were delighted.

It is located directly next to the MRT Shandao Temple station, about a 10-minute walk from Taipei Station, and we could walk to the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall in about 15 minutes with the children. It was a convenient and comfortable stay for 4 nights.

Everyone at the hotel was very polite, and they pressed the elevator button for me, and they opened the door every time I entered or left the hotel, saying "Have a nice day."
We also received a drink voucher for the cafe next door as a welcome drink.
There were two bottles of water and pajamas like yukata in the room.

After getting tired from walking, I went to "Yamasakura Ren Men and Women Health Shop Yamasakura Ren-san," which is famous for being cheap, polite, and speaking fluent Japanese, and had a ********* massage and exfoliation for 7,300 yen, which I was very satisfied with! Cards are not accepted, but you can pay in ********* dollars or Japanese yen. (You can also get change in Japanese yen)
If I come to Taipei again, I would like to use the Cosmos Hotel.

We really enjoyed our stay at shangrila, food, service and amenities were all excellent.  Definitely will stay here again next time we are in Taiwan.
We really did have a pleasant stay at the hotel. The staffs are friendly and helpful. Facilities are good and the room is nicely set up

The staff was super friendly and helpful. Knowing that we are staying to celebrate our anniversary, they upgrade our room, where it is super spacious and awesome. 
We have an extremely pleasant stay here. Will definitely come stay again! :)
Excellent breakfast and friendly staff!  Just the room a bit humid due to heavy rain.  Need an in-room dehumidify!

All good ~ easy to reach public transportation, nearby got 7-11 & Watson. Friendly staff approach. 

The hotel didn’t provide amenities & breakfast are optional either buffet style or American style which only choose one meal.

Hotel is super clean, accessible and all amenities were working so well. Beds were made well, they were comfy and super duper clean. They give you supplies everyday and replenish whats needed too. I'd love to visit again with friends or family.

Thank you again, Miramar Garden Hotel Team, for this wonderful stay – you made it truly unforgettable for our group!

Their service is good, breakfast was great too. My friend is a muslim, so i requested a muslim meal for her ahead, and the hotel was really throughly provided specific muslim breakfast for her. I like the environment, just couple of things that is not good, the noise from pipe or water flowing sound in the midnight, i assumed somebody probably using the hot bath. Any else its was great. After countless times expressing my fondness for this hotel, they finally had the opportunity to join me this November. Without a doubt, the girls enjoyed the place as much as I do. Cheers!

There are also plenty of convenience stores and local food stalls nearby. The hotel staff were all very polite and helpful throughout my stay. Pleasant journey and pleasant stay

It's a wonderful stay for business in a new neighborhood. There was nearby construction when I stayed there, but rooms are good at soundproofing.
Rooms are spacious with nice view. Staffs are nice that they offered me fresh fruits daily and even chocolate for good sleep at night.

Enjoyed my stay at this hotel. Location is nice and quiet. Amenities are good
Overall it was a pleasant stay. Only the check out was a bit slow, it took the luggages 20min to arrive at lobby.

The in-room onsen was fantastic! Plus the nice views, friendly staff, and highly accessible location. The only minor problem was the breakfast, tried the Taiwanese and Western style but both turned out to be below expectations. Maybe the taiwan restaurants have pampered us too much ;)
Comfortable bed, good location, friendly staff
We enjoyed an excellent stay at Howard Plaza hotel, thanks to its prime location, friendly staff, and impeccably clean rooms and surroundings.

We stayed for three nights on a family trip. To summarize, choosing Miramar Garden was definitely the right choice! It was a very satisfying stay.

The hotel is located about a 10-minute walk from both MRT stations, Zhongxiao Xinsheng and Zhongxiao Fuxing, but we mainly used the Zhongxiao Xinsheng station. While many reviews mention that being far from the station is a downside, we didn’t feel it was too distant since we could cut through the National Taiwan University campus to get there. We enjoyed walking through the calm university grounds, feeling like students.

The area where the hotel is located may not be featured in typical guidebooks, but it is a very worthwhile area to explore, with the nearby Liaoning Night Market offering high-quality dining options and many good restaurants.

Since Taipei itself is not a very large city, if you're going to a farther location without using the MRT, I think it's a good idea to choose to take a taxi directly from the hotel from the beginning. Taxi fares are inexpensive, and in terms of saving time and cost-effectiveness, it's extremely convenient. If you get a taxi from the hotel, the doorman is very courteous and will communicate your destination to the driver, which is reassuring.

Now, having mentioned that there are options for getting around depending on individual circumstances, here are my impressions of the hotel itself. We stayed in a triple room with three beds. I had expected the building to be of a certain standard, so I didn't have any particularly negative impressions. The room was always clean, and during our stay, a hotel staff member came to check if the room had been properly cleaned. (Of course, it was cleaned thoroughly.) We also enjoyed snacks and drinks from the minibar. There are water dispensers on each floor, allowing you to fill up your own bottles or larger containers in your room with water, hot water, or sparkling water. We filled our empty plastic bottles with water before going out.

Next to the front lobby, there's a small café where you can buy cakes and Starbucks coffee. The standard coffee size is similar to a tall size in Japan, and there's a slight discount for guests, making it more economical than in Japan. Every time we returned to the hotel, I would bring coffee bought from there to my room.

Additionally, the bed in our hotel and the two large pillows were extremely comfortable. It might be the most enjoyable bed I've slept in during my travels. While the suitability of the bed and pillows depends on one’s body type, and this is a personal feeling, my family also remarked that they were comfortable.

Due to environmental regulations starting in 2025, amenities such as combs and toothbrushes are not provided in hotel rooms in Taiwan. You can request anything you need at the front desk, so there's no need to worry. By the way, we brought our usual items. Body soap and shampoo are provided in dispensers on the bathroom wall. If you need hair conditioner, be sure to bring your own. A bath sponge for lathering body soap is also convenient.

In Taipei, whether using taxis or the MRT, you walk a lot daily, so having a bathtub or a large public bath on the upper floors was really appreciated for relieving fatigue. Unfortunately, we didn’t have time to use the pool, but next time, I hope to enjoy both the pool and the gym.

Regarding meals, we only had breakfast on the last day and enjoyed Taiwanese breakfast and dishes like noodles and rice at nearby eateries in Taipei. We were particularly into eating out for breakfast, but the hotel breakfast was also delicious, offering plenty of fruits and vegetables.

Near the hotel, next to a 7-Eleven, there are several dining halls frequented by university students, all of which were inexpensive and tasty. My family particularly loved the Dan Dan noodles there. The staff at the shops were also friendly. However, please note that they close on weekends when the university is off. Many breakfast places in the city are also often closed on Saturdays, so it’s best to check in advance.

Others have shared various impressions, so I think it would be good for each person to use them as reference.

I usually don’t write reviews, but I wanted to express my gratitude for the warm treatment we received from the doorman, front desk staff, room attendants, and the entire staff at Miramar Garden, as well as their efforts in maintaining the hotel's comfort. The people of Taipei and the food were truly wonderful. I plan to stay at this hotel again on our next trip. Thank you very much!

Cosmos is a 4 star hotel but it feel almost like a 5-star. In fact, I found it much better than an actual 5-star that's on the other side of the street where I spent 2 nights. Cosmos has much better rooms, nicer bathrooms, significantly larger and better equipped gym and - dare I say it - some style. Not necessarily my style, but it has one. The staff I interacted with were very professional and polite. The room was big, well maintained and I was even provided with fresh fruit, which was a nice touch. I haven't used the restaurant, so can't comment on the quality of food, but I enjoyed my stay at the Cosmos Hotel and would definitely check availablity next time I'm heading to Taipei.

Its weird, the cost for 2 pax is the same as cost of 4 pax staying in the same room. Willing to go back but will try another hotel next time.

The gym and sauna seemed nice as well, although we didn't have an opportunity to use them.  Overall, we were very comfortable here and would stay again on our next visit to Taipei.

We enjoyed the staying very much! Breakfast is a plus.

The local staff were also kind and attentive. Thank you to the cleaning staff, pool and bath staff, and the Japanese concierge who helped us with meals and taxi arrangements. It was a great help.

During our four-day stay, we enjoyed a very delicious breakfast. Fresh juice, steak in the morning, and the Taiwanese bananas that you can’t find in Japan these days were served. They were delicious. This type of breakfast, which is favored by Japanese people, is quite high in quality.

Lastly, be sure to enjoy the large public bath, mist sauna, and dry sauna! They are great for both body and mind.

We were thrilled by the view and by the comforts of the room -- the essentials (Wi-fi, bottled water, and bath-cum-shower with reliable hot water) as well as the little luxuries (from toiletries to yoga mat). 

Our room did not have a writing desk, so we had to set up our laptop on what seemed to be a vanity table with mirror and a low-slung seat. However, we found that the "Executive Garden" on the 7th floor provided a soothing atmosphere as well as desk space to write more comfortably.

We richly enjoyed our stay at the Riviera Hotel and would certainly return on any future visit to Taipei.

Stayed there two nights with my mom and we had a good rest. The room is nothing fancy but it’s comfortable. We particularly loved the dual bathtubs for hot spring and cold bath. They offered a small bottle of nice umeshu as turndown service and we very much enjoyed it. The staff were nice and friendly, they always took extra care of my elderly mother which i really appreciated. Overall we enjoyed the stay and would love to be back in the near future.
3 day stay, all clean and nice. good people, service at the pool could be better but all in all a very pleasant stay

Rarely leave a review but this hotel is amazing

We enjoyed their onsen facilities and bar. However, their service after checkout can be improved.

The staff service is very efficient.

A very pleasant stay.

Three people stayed in a suite for three nights. Thanks to Agoda's exclusive price, we were able to enjoy a spacious 66 square meter room and a leisurely luxurious time. The extra bed was somewhat cramped and lacked comfort. There were even days when amenities and water for only two people were provided, indicating some shortcomings in service consistency, but overall, we had a very pleasant stay.

All the staff members were very friendly. I was especially pleased with the staff in the breakfast area who welcomed us warmly. They interacted with us using a mix of basic Japanese and English, gestures, and smiles, making for a wonderful breakfast experience. Over the three days we enjoyed breakfast, the menu changed slightly each day, catering to my father who wanted local dishes, my mother who wanted tropical fruits, and my eldest son who doesn’t quite like local food and opted for regular breakfast items like white rice, miso soup, bacon, potatoes, and eggs. On the other hand, my younger son happily tried many dishes and seemed to really enjoy desserts such as regular Yakult about the size of Japan's Yakult 1000, pudding that couldn't be flipped like the Pucchin Pudding, and yogurt that overflowed when the lid was opened.

I was moved to find that our room had already been cleaned when we returned from breakfast. Every day, bottled water was provided based on the number of guests, so it was convenient to put it in the fridge before going out, allowing us to enjoy cold water when we came back from sightseeing.

I particularly liked that the bathroom had a clear partition instead of a shower curtain. The wet floor can be quite stressful, so I was able to use the sink and toilet comfortably. I did wonder why the toilet paper was positioned as it was, but it's something we can laugh about, so it wasn't a problem.

When I made the hotel reservation, the room amenities included a bathrobe, but it was not available in reality. I’m not sure if it was a mistake from the booking site, but if someone absolutely needs one, it might be good to check beforehand.

There is a weighing scale in the room, which was helpful for measuring our luggage.

The MRT entrance is very close to the hotel, making it extremely convenient.

If I have the opportunity to travel to Taiwan again, I would definitely want to stay at this hotel again. It was a fun trip! Thank you very much to everyone at Cosmos Hotel!

We enjoyed our 6 nights stay in this hotel, with beautiful & spacious room of 30 sq. meters. The bath tube was big and nice. The design of the room was very practical and to our liking. We enjoyed the self refilled sparkling water too. The only problem was you will need to bring your own tooth brush & tooth paste that were not provided. We loved the hospitality of all the staff there. Especially Ms Ori Wu who remembered my name after helping us with the reserving of food at Le Palais. She was so nice and we loved her beautiful smile. She provided us with her best excellent and caring services every time we met her, like telling us how to get to the nearby train station, took initiative to help us to take photos at the 1st floor lobby, as well as caring for our luggage on our departure day, etc. Ms Patty who helped us to get a cab on a rainy day so we would not get wet waiting in the rain. (We were dressed up for a wedding) Ms Ellen took initiative to show us the way to get good food from the night market nearby. Last but not least, Ms Sidney at 6th floor lobby who helped us to check-in and her male colleague who helped us to book a table at Le Palais upon our arrival. Other staff who helped us to check when we should leave the hotel in order to go to the airport at ease, how to walk to the airport express station with our 3 luggage etc . :D with the above good staff and good services really made a different, and we would like to express our heartfelt thanks to all of you. There are many good & famous food at Q Square mall, loved all the souffle pancakes at Woosa at level 1 . Taipei Station Mall was with many food choices too. The transport network and the underground shopping street make it accessible to all attractions easily. We will come back again when we are in Taipei.
Professional and friendly staff. Probably the newest looking hotel in the area

Overall, it was quite a pleasant stay! The food was really... one of the few meals I enjoyed in Taiwan. The flavor was subtle, so my whole family enjoyed it refreshing. The Chinese restaurant room service has a limited menu, but they do takeout. We ordered takeout to eat in the room and were satisfied with the freshness of the ingredients, taste, and price. The café serving Western-style dishes has a lot of food and it’s delicious... the charcoal-grilled sandwich is tasty... They even wrote a card for the cake since it was my birthday, which made me happy. My parents mentioned that they regretted only staying for one night, so I felt proud of choosing this accommodation. However... sigh... the taxi ride to the airport after checkout was scary. The taxi driver was really dozing off from the beginning to the end, swerving between lanes on the highway, almost causing an accident several times... He kept applying pain relief balm and drinking iced water, trying to stay awake... Luckily there weren’t too many cars, but it would have been impossible to shout since we didn’t speak the same language, and even though I tried to talk loudly and used Papago to communicate, the driver kept dozing off which was really frightening.
